tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rim lnga bsdus gsal gyi ṭī ka bzhugs/

bla ma dang sangs rgyas la phyag mtshal lo/ /rdo rje 'dzin dbang dkyil 'khor la/ /gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal nas/ /shin tu zab pa'i man ngag gzhung*/ /mdo tsam 'chad la spro ba skyes/ /'dir rim lnga bsdus gsal gyi don cung zad bkrol na/ 'di'i skad dod la 'dra min gnyis yod de/ dpe kha cig las/ rgya gar skad du/ pañca kra ma sang gra ha pra kā sha bod skad du/ rim pa lnga bsdus pa gsal ba zhes pa yod/ dpe kha cig las/ sang gra ha'i tshab tu saṃ k+ṣip+ta ces pa yod/ de yang pañca ni lnga/ kra ma ni rim pa/ sang gra ha ni bsdus pa ste/ 'thor ba rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa lta bu'i don yin/ saṃ k+ṣip+ta bsdus pa'i don la 'jug pa ni/ rgyas bsdus gnyis kyis zlas phye ba'i bsdus pa ste/ mdor bsdus pa'i don no/ /pra kā sha ni rab tu gsal ba'am/ gsal ba tsam mo/ /dpe mang por/ saṃ gi ta dang*/ saṃ ga ta dang*/ pra bha wa zhes 'don pa ni yi ge ma dag pa'o/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ni/ gzhung rtsom pa pos phyag 'tshal ba ste/ don gyis mchog brjod yin no/ /da ni gzhung gi don bshad par bya ste/ de la mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ man ngag gi che ba ste rnam pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba che/ rim pa lnga la gnas pa po/ dngos po'i gnas lugs lam dang ni/ 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ de la dngos po'i gnas lugs ni/ rgyud gsum las rgyu rgyud de/ dngos ni sems rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba dang*/ yan lag ni 'khor ba'i chos rnams so/ /lam ni thabs kyi rgyud de/ dngos ni rim pa lnga'am drug gi ye shes dang*/ yan lag ni/ rim pa de rnams ma grub pa grub par byed pa'i thabs man ngag rnams dang*/ thun mtshams kyi spyod pa la sogs pa'o/ /dam tshig dang*/ bskyed rim dang*/ cho ga'i las kyi rim pa dang*/ las tshogs dang*/ las tshogs dang*/ thun mong gi dngos grub sogs kyang de la 'dus so/

/yang dbang bskur rgyu rgyud du 'chad pa dang*/ sgrub pa po rang rgyu rgyud du 'chad pa'ang yod mod/ 'dir mi spro'o/ /'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa ni 'bras rgyud de dngos ni phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub kyi go 'phang mi slob pa'i zung 'jug dang*/ yan lag ni slob pa'i zung 'jug go / thun mong gi dngos grub kyang 'bras rgyud du 'chad pa'i skabs yod de/ bskyed rim gtan la 'bebs pa'i skabs su/ bskyed rim nyid kyi rang 'bras mthar thug yin pa dang*/ rnam pa 'dra ba la dgongs pa'o/ /rgyud gsum po de'i don yang*/ rim pa lnga la gnas shing tshang ba ste/ 'bras rgyud ni zung 'jug tu 'dus/ rgyu rgyud ni rim lnga so sos gang la gnad du bsnun pa'i gzhi'am rten yin pas/ lnga car gyis bsdus so/ /de lta bu'i 'bras bu sangs rgyas la dngos su sbyor ba'i nye rgyu spyod pa dang*/ mngon byang gong 'og gnyis dang*/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi bzhugs tshul bde ba chen po'i skur 'chad pa dang*/ lam gyi skabs rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i thabs zab mo rnams dang*/ gzhi sems nyid chos kyi dbyings sku gsum rang chas su gdod nas bzhugs pa ste/ de rnams theg pa bla na med par gsung pa'i khyad chos dang*/ stong nyid snying rje thabs mkhas sogs theg chen spyi lugs te/ de dag ni phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kun gyis mngon sum du mdzad cing*/ gzhan la ston pa'i gsang ba chen po'o/ /de la gsang ba chen po ni/ ra ha s+ya zhes pa ste/ de gzhan phal gyis ma rtogs pa'am/ ma thob pa'i don yin pas/ ches shin tu gsang ba'am gsang dgos pa la'ang 'jug ste/ don gyi gtso bo ches mchog tu gyur pas/ phal cher dang thun mong ma yin pa'i don no/ /dper na yid bzhin gyi nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung ni/ nad thams cad sel ba dang*/ gdon rnams srung ba dang*/ mtshan mo yang phyogs thams cad snang bar byed pa dang*/

zas gos kyi char 'bebs pa sogs/ gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan bzang po dpag tu med pa yod pas/ ra ha s+ya zhes mchog gi don dang*/ de 'dra ba'i dngos po mchog bla na med pa de/ phal gyi lag tu thob pa lta zhog mig gi mthong ba yang ma yin pa'i phyir/ ched brtad gsang ba la ma ltos par/ ye gsang yin pa'i phyir yang*/ ra ha s+ya zhes bya'o/ / gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la/ don gyi gzhi 'god pa dang*/ slar yang gtan la dbab pa'i tshul gyis bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ dngos po'i gnas lugs gnyis yin te/ /zhes pa nas/ 'di nyid thob pa'i myur du 'char/ /zhes pa'i bar ro/ /de la gnyis te/ gzhi dngos po'i gnas stabs gtan la dbab pa dang*/ gnad du bsnun pa'i thabs kyi rgyu mtshan dang*/ lam dngos gsal bar bstan pa dang*/ ye shes kyi lam rtags ngos bzung ba'o/ /dang po la dbye ba ni/ dngos po'i gnas lugs gnyis yin te/ /lus dang sems kyi gnas stabs las/ /zhes te/ dngos po'i gnas lugs sam/ gnas stabs de yang*/ rnam gzhag mtha' yas pa yod mod kyi sems dngos po'i gnas stabs dang*/ lus dngos po'i gnas stabs gnyis su 'dus la/ de dag gi dbye ba yang*/ rags dang phra dang shin tu phra/ /thun mong dbyer med rim shes bya/ /zhes te/ gnas stabs gnyis po la/ gnas stabs so so'i don dang*/ thun mong gi don gnyis las/ so so pa'i don ni/ sems rags pa ni dbang zhes lnga sems byung rnam rtog dang bcas pa/ kun rdzob 'khrul pa kho na'i shes pa 'di rnams yin la/ phra ba ni snang ba gsum/ shin tu phra ba ni 'od gsal gyi sems so/ /zhes kyang 'chad mod/ gzhi 'khor ba'i dus kyi snang ba bzhi dang*/ lam gyi snang ba bzhi car cung zad phra ba'i sems yin la/ shin tu phra ba ni gdon ma chos nyid kyi sems rang bzhin 'od gsal lo/ /de bzhin du lus kyi gnas stabs la sha khrag rus pa sogs khams sum cu rtsa drug gi rang bzhin dbyibs su bkod pa'i lus 'dir rags pa yin/

gnas pa rtsa/ g.yo ba rlung/ bkod pa byang chub kyi sems spyir grags pa 'di ni cung zad phra ba yin zhing*/ gnyug ma'i lus mi shigs pa dwangs ma ni shin tu phra ba'o/ /yang rtsa rlung thig le ste gzhi gsum la/ so sor phye na'ang gsum gsum ste/ rtsa bdun khri nyis stong ni rags pa/ 'khor lo bzhi'i rtsa dang*/ ro rkyang dbu gsum ni phra ba snying ga la sogs pa mi shigs pa'i rtsa ni shin tu phra ba'o/ /yang na ro rkyang phra ba/ dbu ma ches phra ba zhes kyang zer/ g.yo ba rlung la/ rlung bcu la sogs pa khams lnga'i rlung ni rags pa/ snang gsum gyi bzhon pa'i rlung ni phra ba/ 'od gsal gyi rlung ni shin tu phra ba'o// bkod pa byang sems la so sen sha khrag sogs rags pa/ rtsa nang gnas pa'i dkar dmar sogs bdud rtsi lnga ni phra ba/ mi shigs pa'i thig le ni shin tu phra ba'o/ /de dag ni gnas thabs so so'i don yin la/ gnyis pa lus sems thun mong gi gnas thabs sam/ lus sems dbyer med kyi rim pa yang shes par bya ste/ de bshad pa/ gnyid dang rmi lam snyoms 'jug pa/ /tha mal dus dang rnam pa bzhi/ /'khor lo bzhi yi bdag nyid kyi/ /rtsa dang thig le sems shes pas/ / zhes 'byung bas sems zhes pa yan chad de/ sems dang rtsa rlung thig le re re bzhin yang phra rags gsum gsum byung mod kyi/ sems kho nas bya ba mi byed/ rtsa rkyang pa'i las mi byed/ rlung 'ba' zhig gis ma yin thig le gcig pus kyang mi 'grub pas/ rtsa rlung thig le gsum po sems dang bcas pa la phra rags gsum gsum yod pa thams cad bsdoms nas/ gzhi 'khor ba dang*/ lam gyi chos thams cad snang bar byed do/ /de yang rtsa 'khor lo bzhi'i bdag nyid de dngos po rnams gtso bor gyur pa yin la/ de'i yang snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa dang rlung dang thig le'i byed pa las/ gnyid 'thug po'i gnas skabs gtso bor gyur pa/ yid kyi g.yo ba glo bur du 'gags pa'i gnas skabs kyi 'khrul pa rnams 'char la/

lam bsgoms pas gnas skabs de lam du 'khyer zhing sgrib pa spong pa la yang snying gar gnad du bsnun pa'i thabs dgos so/ /mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa rlung thig le'i nus pa las/ rmi lam gyi snang ba gtso bor gyur pa/ rags pa'i khams las 'das te phra ba'i gsal snang 'char ba'i gnas skabs 'byung zhing*/ gnas skabs de nyid lam du byed cing sgrib pa spong ba'i lam/ rmi lam gyi gdams ngag kyang*/ mgrin par gnad du bsnun pa dgos te bar do'i gdams ngag gi phyogs gcig la yang ngo*/ /spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo'i rtsa rlung thig le'i nus pa las/ dbang po gnyis snyoms par 'jug pa gtso bor gyur pa'i 'dzag bde chags pa'i rnam rtog gi snang ba sna tshogs 'char bar 'gyur la/ gnas skabs de lam du 'khyer zhing sgrib pa spong ba'i rang lus gzhan lus kyi gtum mo'i rnal 'byor gyi man ngag rnams kyang*/ spyi bo'i rtsa 'khor la gnad du bsnun pa'i thabs dgos pa yin/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i rtsa rlung thig le'i byed pa las/ tha mal gnyid sad pa'i dus kyi snang ba rags pa sna tshogs pa'i 'khrul ba 'di 'byung ba yin zhing gnas skabs de lam du 'khyer zhing*/ sgrib pa spong ba'i lam mnyam bzhag sgyu lus gtso bor gyur pa rnams kyang*/ lte ba'i 'khor lor gnad du bsnun pa zhig dgos pa yin no/ /'di ni dgyes rdor las/ skye gnas snying mgrin mgo bor yang*/ /sku gsum po ni rnam par gnas/ /zhes sogs rgyas par gsung ba'i dbang du byas la/ dus kyi 'khor lo las/ gong du smos pa 'di dang 'dra ba dang*/ go bzlog pa'i bshad tshul gnyis ka byung ste/ don mi 'gal ba'i phyir/ gdams ngag 'di dag tu yang gnyis ka'i rnam gzhag rung ngo*/ /'o na 'dus pa 'phags skor ba'i lugs kyi/ snying ga'i byed pas dpe don gyi 'od gsal sgrub dgos shing*/ rgyu de las sgyu lus sgrub pa'i gnas kyang snying ga nas byed pa ma yin nam/

'dir sgyu lus lte ba nas sgrub ces pa ci zhe na/ spyir na sems kyi snang ba la shar ba la snying ga nas spros pa zhes kyang yod pas snying ga'i sgra sems la 'jug pa dang*/ rtsa 'khor thams cad kyi lte ba la snying ga'i ming gis bstan pa yang yod pas/ snying ga zhes pa'i tshig tsam la bsten nas byang khog stod kyi nang kho na'o snyams pa'i hob bcos mi bya ste/ lte ba zhes pa'ang rtsa 'khor thams cad kyi lte ba la 'jug pa'i gnas skabs yod pa bzhin no/ /'on kyang rdo rje 'phreng ba dang 'phags skor rnams las/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo nyid sngags pa'ang yin mod kyi/ gnad du bsnun pa'i thabs la nges pa med de/ snod kyi 'og phyi rol tu rdo khab len bskor bas/ snod kyi nang du lcags thur 'khor ba dang*/ shing gi rtsa ba la chu drangs pas/ rtse mo'i me tog kha bye par 'gyur ba bzhin/ rtsa gnas gcig la gnad du bsnun pa'i thabs/ rtsa gnas gzhan gyi byed dgos pa mang ngo*/ /'dir rtsa dang zhes pa'i dang yig gis rlung yang zur gyis bstan te/ de ltar na rtsa dang rlung dang thig le dang sems te/ chos bzhi po de dag 'khor lo bzhis phye ba'i mthu las 'khor 'das thams cad snang ba yin no 'khor lo bzhi dang 'od gsal la sogs pa lam bzhi sbyor ba 'di/ 'phags skor gyi rang gzhung rnams na gsal bar med kyang*/ dgyes rdor sogs ma rgyud kyi dgongs pas kha skong ba 'di/ nā ro'i man ngag mar pa'i dgongs pa yin la/ rdo rje 'phreng ba'i rgyud kyi don yang yin no/ /gnyis pa gnad du bsnun pa'i thabs kyi rgyu mtshan ni/ rtsa dang thig le sems shes pas/ zhes pa'i shes pas zhes dang*/ lus dang dus dang yul rlung gi gnad ni bzhi ru shes par bya/ dran pa sna tshogs rtog pa rnams/ /sems la yang dag byung bas na/ /rnam shes srog ni 'du ba'i rten/ /snying gar sngags kyi 'khor lo bsgom/ /zhes te gong du smos pa ltar gang la gnad du bsnun pa'i gzhi/

lus rtsa rlung thig le dang*/ sems rang bzhin spros bral rang gi rig pa/ rnam pa phra rags kyi dbye ba dang bcas pa rnams/ rang gi rgyud thog tu 'bab nges pa'i blo gros kyis shes par byas nas/ bsgom pa'i tshe/ so so'i lus gnad 'khrul 'khor legs par nges pa dang*/ dus kyi gnad kyang ngal dub dang 'grangs ches pa sogs ma yin pa/ snga dro sgyu lus/ phyi dro rmi lam/ nang nub rlung sbyor drag po sogs man ngag las 'byung ba'i dus gnad rnams dang*/ gang la sgom pa'i yul gyi gnad dmigs pa gtod sa ma nor ba dang*/ rlung gi gnad sor 'jog dang*/ bum pa can la sogs pa ste/ dmigs pa gang bsgoms kyang gnad ni bzhi po 'di ru tshang bar byas te sgom dgos par shes par bya'o/ /yul kyi gnad bye brag tu bshad pa ni/ rnam shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i rnam rtog sna tshogs pa dang*/ srog ste rlung gi tshogs rnams ni/ dbu mar 'du zhing sdud par byed pa'i dmigs rten sgrub pa po rang gi snying gar sngags kyi 'khor lo bsgom par bya'o/ /'dis ni dngos su rim lnga 'khor lo can gyi sngags 'khor de gtso bor bstan pa yin mod/ shugs la 'khor lo med pa dang*/ sems dpa' gsum brtseg dang gtum mo sogs kyang bstan pa yin te gnad dang dgos pa 'dra ba'i phyir ro/ /de yang dran pa sna tshogs pa ste chags yul dran pa las 'dod chags dang*/ gnod byed dran pa las zhe sdang dang*/ yul bar ma dran pa las gti mug sogs rnam par rtog pa 'di rnams snang ba gsum gyi dbye bas phye ba'i rang rig tsam las yang dag par byung ngo*/ /de dag kyang rang rang gi bzhon par gyur pa'i rlung g.yo ba na/ shes pa de dang de gsal bar snang ba yin te/ rlung thim pa na shes pa de rnams kyi thim par 'gyur ro/ /de yang dkar po snying stobs kyi rlung g.yos pas/ snang ba'i ye shes pa skye la/ de'i nus pas chags bral gyi bzhon par 'gyur ba'i rlung rnams ldang zhing*/

de dang lhan cig tu chags bral lam zhe sdang gi rnam rtog rnams skye'o/ /de'i mtshon nas dmar po rdul gyi rlung dang*/ mched pa'i sems dang*/ 'dod chags kyi bzhon pa'i rlung dang*/ 'dod chags kyi rnam rtog rnams sbyar ro/ /de bzhin du nag po mun pa'i rlung dang*/ snang ba thob pa'i shes pa dang*/ gti mug gi bzhon pa'i rlung dang*/ gti mug gi rnam rtog ces bya'o/ /des na ngag don ni/ rlung sems 'jug pa gcig pa'i gnad kyis*/ lus kyi gnad gang du sems gnas pa der/ sems de'i bzhon pa'i rlung yang gnas par 'gyur/ de gnas pas chus chu 'dren pa ltar rlung gzhan rnams kyang rim gyis de'i 'du bar 'gyur ro/ /lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i gtso bo yang*/ rtsa dbu ma kho na yin zhing*/ 'dir snying ga'i 'khor lo spyi dang*/ rtsa dbu ma'i nang gi mi shigs pa la gnad du bsnun pas thog mar dbang shes lnga dang*/ rnam rtog sna tshogs pa'i rlung rnams dbu ma la phyogs par 'gyur zhing de rjes de rnams kyi rtsa ba 'byung ba lnga'i rlung sems rnams kyang phyogs par 'gyur la/ de nas de rnams chags bral gyi bzhon pa'i rlung dang*/ snang ba'i rlung la 'dre/ de chags rtog dang mched pa'i rlung la 'dre/ de rmongs rtog dang thob pa'i rlung la 'dre/ de 'od gsal gyi rlung dang 'dres pa las/ snang ba bzhi'i nyams myong ci rigs pa 'char bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas lo zlar sbyangs pas rim pa de nyid kyis rlung thim tshul je che je che la mthar shin tu thim pa'i skabs shig tu sems dben mthar thug gi 'od gsal gyi bar du skye'o/ /zhes pa 'di grub bo/ /gsum pa lam dngos gsal bar bshad pa la/ lam dngos kyi dbye ba/ sngags kyi 'khor lo rgyas bshad/ rim lnga'i go rim rgyu 'bras te gsum las/ dang po ni/ gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rim shes pas/ /lus dben sngags dang sems gsum gyi/ /sgyu ma mngon par byang chub pas/

/zung 'jug rim pa shes par 'gyur/ /zhes te/ gzhi rten gyi chos/ lam sgom pa'i tshul/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bzhugs tshul te/ rgyud gsum gyi rim pa shes pas ni/ lam gyi rim pa mtha' dag shes par 'gyur te/ 'dir skabs su bab pa ni rdzogs pa'i rim pa ste/ de yang lus dben dang*/ sngags te ngag dben dang sems gsum zhes pas sems dben dang*/ sgyu ma'i lus bdag byin brlab pa'i rim pa dang*/ 'od gsal mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa dang*/ zung 'jug gi rim pa'am mi gnas pa'i myang 'das kyi rim pa ste/ so sor phye bas drug yin la/ dang po gnyis gcig tu bsdoms te/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa'i rim pa zhes byas na rim pa lnga'o/ /'dir byed pa po'i sgra gnyis ni rgyu 'bras su ston pa ste/ sems gsum gyis zhes byed po'i sgra ni/ sems dben gyi bde stong mthar phyin pa'i byed pas sgyu lus kyi sku 'grub/ ces dang mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa don gyi 'od gsal gyis ni zung 'jug gi sku 'grub bo zhes pa'o/ /gny-is pa ni/ sngags kyi yi ge'i 'khor lo ni/ dang por chu skyes 'dab brgyad pa/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i tshul gyi ni/ /rim pa ldan par bsam gtan bya// phyir rim shes rab dbyangs yig mtshan/ /bar ma gsal byed thabs bcas pa// gnyis su med pa nang mar gnas/ /phyogs mtshams rim pa ting nge 'dzin/ / sbyor ba rnam pa gsum rang bzhin/ /dbus su mi shigs thig le ste/ /a dang bcas pa srog gyur gang*/ /kun gyi snying po spro zhing sdud/ /zhes 'dir gong du zur tsam smos pa'i/ snying gar sgom rgyu'i sngags kyi yi ge'i 'khor lo ni/ chu skyes 'dab ma brgyad pa/ phyi rim dkar po 'dab brgyad dang*/ nang rim mthing ga 'dab brgyad dang*/ gsang ba rim pa bar ma dmar po 'dab brgyad de/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis ni/ rim pa gsum dang ldan par bsgom pa'i bsam gtan bya'o/ /'khor lo la yi ge 'god tshul ni/

phyi rim la shes rab ste/ bde stong snang ba'i rang bzhin dbyangs yig gis mtshan pa dang*/ bar ma la thabs gsal stong mched pa'i rang bzhin gsal byed dang byas pa dang*/ nang ma la shes rab snang ba dang*/ thabs mched pa gnyis su med pa/ bde gsal cha mnyam zhing mi rtog pa'i stong nyid 'thug po thob pa'i ngo bor gnas pa'i rang bzhin ni ma ning gi dbyangs bzhi'o/ /de yang phyi ma dang bar ma la/ phyogs mtshams kyi 'dab brgyad kar la yi ge 'god/ nang ma'i phyogs bzhi la 'god pa'i rim par ting nge 'dzin te gsal snang thob par bya'o/ /snying ga ni mtshon pa tsam ste rtsa 'khor gzhan la yang ji ltar rigs pa bsgom mo/ /sbyor ba rnam pa gsum zhes pa ni/ rtsa 'khor rim pa gsum po de la dmigs pa bstad na/ snang mched thob gsum gyi ye shes skye ba'i nus pa yod pas de'i rang bzhin zhes bya ste/ bur shing bu ram gyi rang bzhin zhes pa dang 'dra'o/ /'khor lo de'i dbus su 'khor lo'i lte bar gyur pa/ rtsa dbu ma'i nang na mi shigs pa'i thig le gnas te/ de nyid ngag thams cad kyi rtsa ba yi ge a thung dang bcas pa/ srog gi rlung dwangs mar gyur pa gang de bsgom par bya'o/ /de la mi shigs pa'am gzhom du med pa'i thig le ni/ kun rdzob kyi gnas stabs ltar na/ snying ga'i dbus kyi rtsa dbu ma'i nang rtsa chu shing gi me tog ces bya ba'i dbus na/ dkar dmar rlung gsum gyi dwangs ma las shin tu dwangs mar yungs dkar sbom po'am tsa na ka'i tshad tsam 'ja' tshon shar ba lta bur gnas la/ rlung de yang drod kyi rang bzhin du bshad cing*/ yul rung ba na gnas pa ma yin pas/ skye bo phal pas mi mthong yang*/ mngon shes mchog dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i spyod yul te khams brgyad 'dus pa yin pa'i phyir/ gzugs can rdul gyi khams su gtogs la/ gzugs snang shin tu gsal ba dang*/ reg thogs shin tu phra ba tsam yod do/ /de la brten pa'i sems kyang yul snang sna tshogs dang*/

rnam rtog sna tshogs kyi rigs su ma chad pa'i rang rig bde ba tsam zhig de dang 'dres nas gnas la/ thig le de'i mdangs dang*/ dad pa dang*/ nus pas lus sems kun la khyab cing*/ kun rdzob snang ba sna tshogs pa bskyed pa'i rtsa rlung thig le thams cad 'di la brten nas 'byung ba'ang yin no/ / don dam pa'i gnas stabs ni ngo bo spros bral gyi sems nyid rang bzhin 'od gsal de kho na yin kyang rnam gzhag spyi khyab rgya yan pa de tsam gyis/ stong hang hang cham cham mtho zang zang gi khungs cig ma gtogs/ go ba rnal ma cig mi skye bas/ gsang sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i chos skad kyi go ba cig dgos so/ / go ba mdo dang thun mong ma yin pa las med pa dang*/ mdo lugs kyi go ba'ang phyogs 'gro tsam yang med par/ bag med kyi rgyab skyor du gsang sngags log pa'i chos skad re re tsam khyer yong ba la snying po cung zad tsam yang yod pa ma yin no/ /'dir bshad pa/ rang bzhin 'od gsal gyi sems de/ yod med yin min rtag chad skye 'gags mtha' dbus sogs spros pa thams cad dang bral/ sgra dang rtog pa'i yul las 'das pas/ blta bzung med/ yul dus gang du'ang ma grub kyang*/ ngo bo rig pa bde ba chen po 'gyur med du gnas pas/ rnam cha kun rdzob kyi shes pa gang la'ang mi snang mod/ rang gi ngo bo gdod ma nas rnam pa thams cad du rtag tu shar ba cig yod/ de shes bya kun la nye ring med par khyab pa yin kyang*/ kun rdzob rnam shes 'khor bcas la gzugs can la nam mkhas khyab pa ltar khyab pa ste/ khyab bya rnam shes kho rang yang sems rig pa'i rnam par shar ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis thabs la mkhas na/ khyab byed rang bzhin 'od gsal de yang*/ grib ma'i tshul gyis shes pa dang myong bar rung*/ rnam shes yin pa'i ring la/ dngos su rtogs pa ni mi 'byung*/ lam gyi ye shes su gnas gyur na ni rung*/ lam gyi ye shes kyis dngos su rtogs pa dang*/

thabs dang ldan na/ rnam shes kyis kyang grib ma'i tshul du myong ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ rang bzhin 'od gsal dang rnam shes gnyis so/ /shes rig tsam du rnam par mtshungs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin/ gzugs sogs don du snang ba rnams la/ rang bzhin 'od gsal des khyab mod kyang*/ gzugs sogs nyid bem por snang gi shes par mi snang bas/ thabs dang bcas par mi rung zhing bcas kyang rang bzhin 'od gsal grib ma'i tshul gyis nyams su myong ba yang ma yin no/ /don dam mi shigs pa'i thig le de/ chos nyid yin bde gshegs snying po yin/ de shes bya thams cad la dbyer med du khyab kyang*/ re zhig snod kyi 'jig rten sogs la bgros med du bzhag nas/ sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po can no/ /rnam shes dang rnam rtog gi rang bzhin chos kyi sku yin no/ /zhes logs su bkar nas 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan de yin no/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal gyi ye shes lta ci smos/ rnam shes kyang gzugs can ma yin pa'i phyir/ gnas phyogs cha gcig la gnas pa'i nges pa med mod kyi/ 'on kyang rnal 'byor can gyi sems kyi snang ba la/ 'od gsal ye shes de yang rtsa a wa dhū tī'i nang du/ bde ba'i rlung dang thig le 'dres pa'i rnam par snang ba'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ dbu mar rlung thim pa'i rkyen gyis/ de rtogs pa'i ye shes skye ba'i phyir/ dbu ma ye shes kyi rtsar 'jog cing*/ dbu ma'i gnas kyi gtso bo yang*/ chos skor 'di ba'i lugs kyi/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus la bzhed pas/ der gnas pa'i tha snyad byed do/ /de nyid a thung du bshad pa ni/ a yig gi gzugs dang sgra tsam la zer ba ma yin gyi/ ngag dang rlung thams cad 'byung ba'i gzhi yin pa'i phyir te/ ji skad du/ thung ngu ma lus dag du 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /skye ba med pa'i ye shes kyang mtshon te/ snying gi dbus na mi shigs pa/ /gsal zhing mar me dag dang mtshungs/

/mi 'gyur mchog tu phra ba ste/ /a ni gtso bo dam pa'o/ /zhes so/ /de lta bu'i mi shigs pa de ni/ rtsa dang rlung dang thig le dang*/ shes pa kun gyi snying po yin te/ lha mo bzhis zhus pa las/ snying po las ni snying po mchog /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba ni/ /gang de thams cad bdag nyid gnas/ /de ni lha mo bshad par bya/ /ye shes lnga yi dngos de nyid/ /yungs dkar gyi ni 'bru tshod tsam/ /de yi dbus na gnas pa'i lha/ /mi gsal gsal ba'i bdag nyid can/ /zhes so/ /'di ni snang ba sna tshogs pa 'char ba'i gzhi yin pas/ khams gsum spro ba dang*/ mthar gang la thim par 'gyur ba'i gnas yin pas sdud pa po'o/ /yang na rlung rnams thams cad spro ba dang bsdu ba'i gnas yin pa la bshad kyang rung ngo*/ /gsum pa rim lnga'i go rim rgyu 'bras ni/ 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung rnams nyid/ /rlung dang sngags su rab sbyor bas/ /rdo rje'i bzlas pa sbyang bar bya/ / 'byung 'jug gnas pa nyid du bshad/ /tha mal rnam rtog bag chags rnams/ / sngags nyid sems su dmigs pas so/ /lus dag pas ni rtog pa dag /rlung dag pas ni dri med 'gyur/ /rlung dag pas ni ye shes kyi/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma mngon du byed/ /de nyid mngon par byang chub pas/ /zung 'jug ye shes thob par 'gyur/ /zhes pa yin la/ las rnams bya ba 'phrin las tshogs/ /rnam shes ye shes sbyor bas 'grub/ /ces pa 'di 'phros don no/ /'di'i don 'chad pa la/ thog mar bskyed rim dang*/ lus dben kha 'gengs dgos te 'og tu 'chad/ ngag rnam par dben pa ni/ 'byung ba bzhi yi rlung rnams nyid/ /ces pa 'byung chen gyi dbang du byas na pad+ma'i mgon po me/ las kyi mgon po rlung*/ rdo rje mgon po chu/ rin chen mgon po sa'i dkyil 'khor te/ dgu brgya pa phrag re re rgyu bas thun gcig rdzogs te de ltar nyin zhag gcig la thun drug go /'byung chung gi dbang du byas na/

mgon po re re la yang lha mo bzhi bzhis phye ste/ gos dkar mo me/ sgrol ma rlung*/ mā ma kī chu/ spyan ma sa ste/ dbugs nyis brgya nyer lnga re rgyu'o/ /de ltar na gang la bzlas pa bya ba'i gzhi ni/ nyin zhag phrugs gcig la 'byung ba bzhi'i dbugs nyi khri chig stong drug brgya rgyu ba de rnams nyid de/ rlung gi de kho na nyid kyi don bsdus pa'o/ /de 'dra ba'i rlung de dbug de rnams dang*/ yi ge 'bru gsum gyi sngags rab tu sbyor ba shes par bya ste/ de yang 'phags skor gyi lugs 'di ltar na/ rlung phyir 'byung ba hūṃ/ nang du 'jug pa oṃ/ gnas pa āḥyig nyid du sbyar te bshad par bya'o/ /skabs 'dir sngags btub dang*/ sngags kyi don dang*/ sngags kyi brda dang*/ sngags kyi don dam pa ste/ don tshan bzhi po de dag rgyas par shes dgos mod/ rim lnga chen mo nyid du rtogs par bya'o/ /don la yi ge 'bru gsum du sngags thams cad 'dus tshul gyi rnam gzhag shes pa dang*/ yi ge'i gzugs dang*/ yi ge'i sgra'am gzugs la sems brtad de bsgom pa ni sngags kyi de kho na nyid rtogs pa'i thabs ni yin mod/ 'on kyang de dag mtshon byed brda tsam ste/ don ni mang mod kyang gtso bo ni gzugs snang gi rang bzhin dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo snang stong du gdod nas gnas pa de oṃ yig gis mtshon/ rlung nang du 'jug pa dbu mar thim pa'i ye shes kyis de rtogs/ sgra dang ngag tshig thams cad kyi rang bzhin grag stong sgra skad thams cad pa'i sngags su gnas pa de āḥyig gis mtshon/ rlung nang du gnas pa dbu mar thim pa'i ye shes kyis de rtogs/ rig pa thams cad kyi rang bzhin/ thig le 'gyur med kyi bde ba dang*/ stong pa dbyer med du gnas pa de hūṃ yig gis mtshon/ rlung phyir rgyu ba dbu mar 'gags pas de rtogs te/ rtogs tshul yang ngag dben gyi rim pa'i skabs 'dir/ grib ma'i tshul gyis rtogs pa yin te/

grib ma ni gzugs brnyan shar ba la zer ro/ /yi ge gsum gyi gtso bo hūṃ yin zhing*/ rlung gi gtso bo gnas yin kyang*/ ngag dben gyi 'dir gsung gi bzlas pa gtso che bas/ rlung gi gtso bo gnas pa dang*/ gsung gi sngags āḥyig sbyar ro/ /de dag ni sngags kyi de kho na'o/ /de ltar rlung rnams kyi kun rdzob kyi gnas stabs rlung gi de nyid dang*/ don dam gyi gnas stabs sngags kyi de nyid go zhing shes nas/ bzlas pa'i de nyid ces bya ba/ ngag dben gyi nyams len rdo rje'i bzlas pa la bslab cing sbyang bar bya'o/ /de yang gnyis med rnam rgyal las/ mnyam med sngags ni bzlas nas su/ /sgrub pa'i bdag nyid can gyis sgrub/ /de yis zla ba gcig gis ni/ khams gsum sgrub par gdon mi za/ /rnam shes las ni byung ba'i sngags/ /mtshan nyid drug ldan bzlas nas kyang*/ /rdo rje sems dpar phyag byas na/ /zla ba nya la de 'grub 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ khams gsum ni snang ba gsum gyi sa te ngag dben la brten nas sems dben 'grub pa la dgongs so/ /mtshan nyid drug po ni/ bgrang pa dang*/ rnam par dpyad pa dang*/ gnas pa dang*/ rtog pa dang*/ bzlog pa dang*/ rtog bcas spangs pa ste/ spyir rdor bzlas kyi dbye ba drug yod pa las/ dang po gsum po ngag dben gyi bzlas pa'i skabs su sbyor ro/ /de yang rdo rje 'phreng ba las/ dbugs kyi tshad ni bgrang ba dang*/ /rlung gi rnam par dpyad pa dang*/ /gnas kyi dbye ba rtsa rnams kyi'o/ /dus kyi dbye ba rtog pa dang*/ /rlung rnams kyi ni bzlog pa dang*/ /rtog dang bcas pa spangs pa ste/ /de ltar mdor bsdus rnam drug gis/ /'byung dang rngub pa zhes su brjod/ /ces gsungs te/ dang po ni rgyu ba nges pa yin/ gnyis pa ni rnam pa gsal ba yin/ gsum pa ni/ rtsa gang nas rlung gang rgyu shes pa yin/ ngag dben gyi skabs der gsum po de'o/ /bzhi pas rlung gang dang gang gis rnam rtog de dang de bskyed pa shes pas rtog pa dang rtog med kyi sa mtshams mngon sum du rig pa ste/

sems dben gyi rim pa'i skabs kyi rdor bzlas dang*/ lnga pas rnam rtog rnams sgyu ma lta bur shes pas rtog med du gnas 'gyur bar rtogs pas/ sgyu lus kyi rim pa'i skabs kyi rdor bzlas dang*/ drug pas rtog pa spangs pa'i rtog med kyi ye shes mngon du byed pas 'od gsal gyi rim pa'i rdor bzlas so// 'dir bshad pa'i/ bgrang dang rnam dpyad gnas pa dang*/ /rtog dang zlog dang rtog bcas spangs/ /zhes pa'i drug po 'di mdo lugs nas/ bgrang dang rjes 'gro 'jog pa dang*/ /rtog dang bsgyur dang yongs dag go /zhes pa dang don yang phyogs 'dra zhing*/ 'gyur khyad dang ming gi rnam grangs ma gtogs ming gcig kho na'o/ /de la skabs 'dir rdo rje'i bzlas pa zhes pa ni/ rags pa'i dbugs 'di rags pa'i rtsa dbu mar zhugs gnas thim gsum brtan por song ba'i skabs/ mnyam bzhag tu rlung 'jug gnas ldang gsum thams cad kyis bde stong gi ye shes skyed par byed pa cig yod pa de la zer bas/ bum pa can dang*/ rdul mtha' can dang*/ gang ba can dang*/ rengs pa can dang*/ rtsa lam sbyong ba'i rdor bzlas sogs gang byas kyang*/ thams cad rdo rje'i bzlas pa yin gyi/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa zer na rtsa sbyong rdor bzlas kho na la mi gzung ngo*/ /de ni rtsa lam sbyong byed la rdor bzlas zhes spyi ming bye brag la thogs pa'o/ /yang rtsa lam sbyong byed yin zhes byas pa ni/ kha cig sngon 'gro lam sel tsam yin gyi/ rlung dbu mar thim byed kyi rlung sbyor dngos gzhi min zer bar 'dug smad ra btang byung bsam nas/ tshig pa za bar byed mod/ rtsa lam sbyangs pas kyang rlung dbu mar thim par 'gyur ro/ /de bas na rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang srog rtsol la rgya che chung yod pa ma yin no/ /de dag ni bzlas pa'i kho na nyid de/ ngag dben bshad zin to/ /gong du bshad pa'i sngags nyid kyi don/ rlung dbu mar 'gags pa'i stobs las thob pa'i gsal stong gi rig pa ngag tshig brjod bral du shar ba la/

bde ba dang lha skus brgyan pa de nyid kyi rgyun slar yang zhu bde'i thig le rtsa 'khor rnams su brtan par gyur pa'i bde stong gi sems la dmigs pa'i ting nge 'dzin te sems rnam par dben pa des tha mal gyi rnam rtog rang bzhin brgyad cu'i bag chags rnams dag par byed do/ /de yang lus thig le dag pa de brtan par gyur pas ni/ rnam par rtog pa mngon gyur ba dag pa ste/ mnyam bzhag tu yang yang 'gag par 'gyur la/ rnam rtog gi bzhon pa'i rlung dag cing dngos su 'gag pas ni/ bag chags kyi dri ma med par 'gyur zhes pa'o/ /de yang rdor bzlas kyi rim pa'i skabs/ rlung dbu mar thim pa'i ye shes kho na gtso bo yin/ yan lag tu rtsa dbu mar lugs 'byung lugs zlog byas pa'i dga' bzhi'i bde stong tsam yod mod kyang*/ thig le rtsa 'khor du brtan zhing chags pa'i bde stong med pa las 'dir de yod do/ /de lta bu'i bde stong gi ye shes kyi mthu las/ snang ba gsum gyis rgyud la skye ba yin te/ bde stong la dmigs pas ldang rtog gi rlung 'gags/ thig le cung zad brtan pas/ mnyam bzhag tu rang bzhin so gsum mngon 'gyur ba 'gag cing*/ snang ba'i sa thob/ bde ba la dmigs pas rags rtog gi rlung 'gags/ thig le 'bring tsam brtan/ rang bzhin bzhi bcu mnyam bzhag tu 'gags/ mched pa'i sa thob/ yang bde ba la dmigs pas rmongs rtog gi rlung 'gags/ thig le chen por brtan/ rang bzhin bdun mnyam bzhag tu 'gags/ thob pa'i sa'o/ /'dir bag chags dag par gsung ba ni/ bag la nyal dang sa bon dag pa ma yin/ rnam rtog de dag skye ba'i gzhi dbang po dang yul gyi snang ba de mnyam bzhag tu thim pa'i ming ngo*/ /thob pa'i sa mthar thug pa na/ khams phra rags 'od gsal la thim tshul khams drug ldan pa'i mi zhig 'chi ba'i dus kyi thim tshul las/ stobs mi chung ba'i bde stong 'od gsal la ngang gis gnas pa zhig 'byung ste/

sems dben mthar thug gi 'od gsal lam/ nyer thob bzhi pa'i sa zhes ming 'dogs so/ /de ltar rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam rtog gi rlung rags pa rnams mnyam bzhag tu 'gags pa'i tshul gyis dag pas rnal 'byor pa'i rlung sems bde ba'i ngo bor gyur pa na/ ye shes kyi sku kun rdzob bden pa sgyu ma'i lus/ bdag byin brlab pa'i rim pa mngon du byed do/ /rlung sems tsam gyi dwangs ma'i gzhi lus te/ rags pa'i lus la me tog dang*/ me tog gi dri ltar gdod nas gnas kyang mi mthong zhing bya ba mi byed pa de/ phra rags thim rim gyi mthar 'chi sems gyi 'od gsal shar bas dwangs snyigs bye ste bar do'i lus rang snang la lus kyi bya ba byed nus de mngon du 'gyur ba bzhin du/ sgrub pa po'i rlung sems kyi lus sngar sha khrag gi lus la 'dres nas mi mthong zhing bya ba mi byed pa de/ 'chi sems las stobs mi chung ba'i nyer thob bzhi pa'i 'od gsal des dwangs snyigs bye nas rnal 'byor pa rang nyid kyi snang ngo la/ lus kyi bya ba byed nus kyi sku/ rgyu rlung sems tsam las grub pa sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis kyis mtshon pa de 'byung ngo dngos grub kyi khyad par gzhan gyis sgrubs na ma gtogs/ de ltar rags pa'i lus gnas gyur pa'i skabs ma yin pas/ dngos su rags lus yod kyang*/ mnyam bzhag gi tshe rags lus kyi snang ba 'gags te ye shes kyi sku kho na snang*/ rjes thob kyi skabs su/ me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar/ tshogs pa gcig tu gnyis kar dus gcig la snang ngo*/ /de lta bu'i sku de thob nas/ rang stobs kyi yon tan rdzogs shing brtan par gyur gyi bar rim pa de ka la gnas pa yin la/ de nas mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa'i rgyu la slob ste/ rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa dang 'brel bar/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid du 'jug pa'i thabs/ ril por 'dzin pa dang*/ rjes su gzhig pa dag gis lha sku de yang 'od gsal bde stong lhan skyes kyi ngang du yang yang sbyang bar bya'o//

de nas mthar phyi dang nang gi mngon par byang chub pa gnyis sbrags te bsgoms pas/ nye ba'i rgyu byas te don gyi 'od gsal mthong lam mngon du 'gyur ba ni/ 'od gsal gyi rim pa'am/ mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa'o/ /don gyi 'od gsal de las langs ma thag tu slob pa'i zung 'jug ye shes kyi sku thob par 'gyur te/ 'di ni dbang phyug brgyad dang ldan pa rdo rje 'chang chung ngu dang*/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chung ngu'i ming yang thob pa yin no/ /skabs 'dir 'od gsal gyi rim pa'i skabs snga ma rnams la/ ma dag pa'i sgyu lus de blo ngor stong pa nyid du bcug kyang*/ dngos gnas la spyod ma thub par yod cing*/ don gyi 'od gsal la thog mar thob pa'i skabs mthong lam du sku de stong par thim zhing*/ yang zung 'jug gi skabs de las langs pa na/ ye shes kyi sku 'byung ngo zhes 'phags skor ba rnams rags bshad du de ltar byed kyang*/ zhib mor na rim pa'i gsum sgyu lus de yang*/ gnyug ma'i lus las grub pa yin zhing*/ zung 'jug gi sku yang gnyug ma'i lus nyid yin pa'i phyir/ mthong lam gyi skabs bar chad par 'dod pa mi 'thad de/ gnyug ma'i lus chad pa mi srid la/ chad pa'i rjes su byung ba de gsar byung yin gyi gnyug mar gzhag tu med pa'i phyir ro/ /bar der thim par bshad pa'i dgongs pa ni/ skabs der ma dag pa'i lus dngos su thim pa'ang yin la/ lhan skyes gnyug ma'i lus ni 'gags pa min yang*/ sngar sku dang dbyibs sogs nges pa can de lhan skyes kyis shin tu rlan pa na/ nges pa can zhig nas mkha' khyab tu gyur pa la/ sku de 'od gsal du thim pa zhes brjod de/ skabs der sgrub po rang la mi snang ba yang yin no/ /zung 'jug gi sku ni/ mkha' khyab de las ma g.yos bzhin du/ nges pa ltar snang ba'i bkod pa mtha' yas pa ston pa'o/ /thugs don gyi 'od gsal dang*/ sku dag pa'i sgyu lus ngo bo gcig tu gnas pa'i phyir zung 'jug ces bya/

sgrub po nyid las dngos dang lus kyi rtsa ba yin zhing*/ de nas rnam 'phrul mtha' yas pa'i sgo nas/ sems can gyi don spyod pas tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs nas 'phags pa'i sa bcu'am bcu gnyis bgrod de/ nye rgyu mngon byang gong ma la brten nas/ mi slob pa'i zung 'jug mngon du byed do/ /de ltar yang rim lnga las/ rlung gi de nyid rim gyis ni/ /sngags kyi de nyid yang dag 'jug /sngags kyi dmigs pa rtogs nas ni/ /rdo rje'i bzlas pa rnams la slob/ /rdo rje'i bzlas gnas rnal 'byor pas/ /sems la dmigs pa thob par 'gyur/ / sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gnas/ /yang dag mthas ni rnam par sbyangs/ /yang dag mtha' las langs nas ni/ /gnyis med ye shes thob par 'gyur/ /zung 'jug ting 'dzin la gnas nas/ slar zhing gang la'ang mi slob bo/ /'di ni rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'ang de/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i/ /thams cad mkhyen par de nas 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ / 'phros don ni/ sbyin sreg la sogs pa'i las kyi cho ga dang bya ba sna tshogs pa dang*/ zhi rgyas la sogs pa'i 'phrin las kyi tshogs rnams kyang*/ bskyed rim pas rnam shes kyi sgo nas dang*/ rdzogs rim pas ye shes kyi sgo nas 'grub par 'gyur te/ ji skad du/ rim lnga las/ me dang rlung dang dbang chen dang*/ /chu ste so so'i dkyil 'khor du/ /thun na phyed phyed dus su ni/ /las ni gnyis gnyis gnas par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don no/ /bzhi pa ye shes kyi lam rtags ngos bzung ba la bstan bshad gnyis kyi mdor bstan pa ni/ rtags rnams rim par 'char ba'i dngos/ ye shes lnga yi rgyu mthun nyams/ gsal snang 'bar ba'i bar du'o/ /zhes te/ lam rtags rnams ngag dben sems dben/ sgyu lus 'od gsal gyi rim pas 'char bar 'gyur pa'i rtags snang gi dngos po ste ngo bo ni/ ye shes lnga dang rgyud la gdod ma nas bzhugs pa'i rgyu mthun pa'i nyams te smig sgyu ni chos dbyings ye shes/

du ba ni me long lta bu/ me khyer ni so sor rtogs pa/ mar me ni bya sgrub/ nam mkha' sprin med ni mnyam nyid do/ /yang na smig sgyu sogs bzhi bya sgrub/ dkar lam le long*/ dmar lam sor rtog nag lam mnyam nyid/ skya rengs lta bu chos dbyings so/ /de ltar bu'i gsal snang de thams cad kyang*/ lus la rtsa dbu mar gtum mo 'bar ba'i ngang nyid du shar ba'o/ / rgyas bshad la/ gong 'og kun gyi thun mong dang*/ sgyu lus dang*/ 'od gsal dang*/ ngag dben dang*/ sems dben dang*/ zung 'jug gi rim pa'i nyams te drug yod pa las/ dang po ni/ yan las rlung las mngon shes thob/ / zhes pa ste/ mig shes sogs dang lhan cig spyod pa/ rgyu ba la sogs pa yan lag gi rlung dbu mar thim pa las/ mig rna ba sna lce lus kyi mngon shes rnams thob par 'gyur la/ der ma zad 'byung ba lnga'i rlung dang rtsa ba'i rlung lnga thim pa'i rtags rnams kyang 'byung ba shes dgos so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rtog pa'i tshogs rnams mar 'gribs shing*/ /snying po ye shes yang 'phel du/ ye shes rim pa rang las rnyed/ /gcig dang du mar dmigs mi byed/ /ces te/ rtog pa'i tshogs ni rang bzhin brgyad cu'o/ /snying po ye shes ni bde stong ste/ de yang mnyam bzhag tu ldang rtogs so gnyis 'gags/ bde stong chung ngu ni snang ba/ de'i steng du chags rtog bzhi bcu 'gags/ bde stong 'bring ni mched pa/ de'i steng du rmongs rtog bdun 'gags shing bde stong chen por longs pas thob pa'o/ /de lta bu'i ye shes gsum gyi rim pa rnams rang lus kyi rtsa rlung thig le ye shes su thim pa'i skabs der rnyed pa yin te/ rtsa dang rlung phal pa rnams dbu mar thim pa dang*/ bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi rtsa 'khor lo bzhi'i brgya nyi shu sogs thim pa dang*/ rtsa 'khor nang ma'i rlung rnams thim pa las/ snang mched thob gsum gyis rim pa skye zhing*/ ye shes gsum gyi sa de dag thams cad ngo bo ni rang bzhin gnas lugs mtshon par nus pa'i zhu bde khyad par can yin la/

rnam pa ni gcig dang du ma sogs pa spros pa'i rnam par dmigs par mi byed pas spros bral lo/ /gsum pa ni/ dang po smig sgyu lta bu'i nyams/ /'od zer lnga dang bcas pa 'char/ /gnyis pa zla ba lta bu dang*/ /gsum pa nyi ma'i 'od kyis 'khrigs// mtshams snang las ni thob pa ste/ /mtshams bral dus kyi ye shes che/ /mngon par byang chub tshul gnas pas/ /dri med ye shes mngon par rdzogs/ /zhes te/ dang po smig sgyu lta bu'i nyams la khams lnga'i cha shas kyi rlung thim pa'i snang ba/ 'od zer snang lnga 'bar bas bskor ba dang bcas pa 'char bar 'gyur te/ du ba dang*/ me khyer dang*/ mar me'i rtags rnams smig sgyu'i khongs su bsdus pa yin/ yongs su grags pa'i rtags lnga las bzhi po dag smig sgyur bsdu ba pa'o/ / gnyis pa snang ba ni/ ston gnam g.ya' dag la zla 'od phog pa lta bu'i dkar lam pa dang bcas pa dang*/ gsum pa snang ba mched pa ni/ nam mkha' dwangs pa la nyi 'od kyis 'khrigs pa lta bur dmar lam pa dang bcas pa/ gsum pa snang ba thob pa ni/ nam mkha' dri ma med pa la mtshams kyi mun nag gis khyab pa lta bu'i snang ba las rtog par 'gyur ba dang*/ lnga pa ni/ thun mtshams kyi rmag rum dang bral ba zhes/ mun nag gi dus las 'das te/ tho rangs skya rengs dang po'i dus kyi nam mkha' ni/ nam mkha'i rang mdog sgrib byed dkar dmar nag gsum gyi mdangs dang bral te/ nam mkha'i rang mdog gsal bar mthong ba dper byas te/ sems kyi rang bzhin bde stong gsal bar snang ba'i ye shes chen po ni/ lhan cig skyes pa mngon par byang chub pa'i tshul 'od gsal te de la gnas pas/ rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam rtog rlung dang bcas pa'i dri ma med cing*/ skad cig bzhi pa 'di skyes pa na/ snang ba bzhi'am/ stong pa bzhi'am/ ye shes bzhi'i rim pa phrugs gcig mngon du byas pa ste rgyud la skyes pa'i tshul gyis cha tshang zhing rdzogs pa yin no/

/de ltar yang rim lnga las/ rang rig tsam gyi ye shes ni/ /nam mkha' lta bur mtshan nyid med/ /'on kyang 'di la dbyer yod de/ /mtshan mo nyid mo mtshams bdag nyid/ /snang dang snang ba mched pa dang*/ /de bzhin snang ba nyer thob pa/ /sems ni rnam pa gsum bshad nas/ /de yi sgrib pa brjod par bya/ /zhes 'byung zhing*/ spyod bsdus sgron me las kyang*/ rim pa 'di yis bstan par bya ste/ dang por smig rgyu lta bu la 'od zer lnga'i tshogs dang ldan par mthong ngo*/ /gnyis pa ni snang ba ste/ zla ba'i 'od zer lta bu'o/ /gsum pa ni snang ba mched pa ste nyi ma'i 'od zer lta bu'o/ /bzhi pa ni snang ba thob pa ste/ mun pa lta bu'o/ /de nas mun pa dang bral ba'i skad cig ma 'od gsal ba ste/ shin tu gsal ba/ rtag tu snang ba'i mtshan nyid can/ don dam bden pa'i rang gi mtshan nyid ye shes kyi mig gis mthong ngo*/ /zhes gsungs/ 'di 'od gsal gyi rim pa'i skabs su gsungs pa yin kyang rtags snang gi 'char tshul ni gong 'og phal cher du 'dra ste/ 'on kyang bskyed rim dang lus kyi rim pa'i skabs su ni/ de rnams cha tshang ba dang ma tshang ba ci rigs su 'byung la/ ngag dben gyi rim pa brtan pa thob pa nas bzung ste/ rgya che chung gi khyad ma gtogs/ go rim de dag ma tshang ba med par 'byung*/ 'on kyang der mnyam bzhag dang gnyid la sogs pa'i skabs su/ cha tshang ba re byung nas/ thun mtshams su ye shes de dag 'gags so/ /sems dben gyi rim pa'i skabs snang ba'i sa thob nas/ snang bas bsdus pa'i bde stong ni rgyun mi 'chad par gnas/ gzhan rnams skye 'gag byed/ 'on kyang gsal mi gsal gyi dbye ba cung zad yod de/ mnyam bzhag tu slar yang gsal btab pa'i tshe/ snang ba'i ye shes de gsal zhing rgya che la/ rjes thob tu bag tsam mi gsal bar 'gyur mod/ yang yang snang bzhi'i ye shes bskyar nas bsgoms pas/ snang ba'i sa'i ye shes te gong nas gong du khyad par du 'gyur ba ni yin no/

/de nas mched pa'i sa thob pa na yang*/ sngar gyi snang ba'i ye shes mi nyams te/ bde stong gi ye shes rtag tu gnas pa'i ngo bo de/ sngar gyi snang ba de phyis mched par gnas gyur pa yin la/ de la snang mched gnyis kar gyi mtshan nyid tshang*/ snang bzhi'i rim pa gsar pa yang yang skyed pa'i gnas skabs su/ skad cig gi snang mched so sor 'char zhing*/ des sa'i ye shes la bogs 'byin no/ /phyi ma rnams la'ang 'dis rigs 'gre ba bya'o/ /'di dag las dang po 'od zer lnga snang ni/ dbang po lnga/ yul lnga/ phung po lnga/ ye shes lnga/ 'byung ba lnga ste rags pa lnga thim pa'i rtags yin/ de dag kyang*/ gzhan nyi shu sngon la thim/ 'byung ba lnga phyis thim pa'o/ /nam mkha' rnam shes la thim pas/ sprin med nam mkha'i rtags 'byung ba la dbye na/ zla 'od/ nyi 'od/ mun nag skya rengs kyi dpes mtshon pa'i snang ba bzhi'o/ /rtags rim pa lnga po 'di dag bskyed rim kho na la gnas pa dang*/ lus dben gyi rim pa'i skabs kyang cung zad 'byung mod kyi/ rags pa'i rlung rags pa'i dbu mar cung zad thim pa'i nus pa'o/ /ngag dben gyi skabs kyang skad cig re re la gsal la rgya che ba 'byung mod kyang*/ rags pa'i rlung phal cher dbu mar thim zhing*/ ye shes kyi rtsa la cung zad reg pa yin mod kyi/ da dung snang ba bzhi'i sa thob pa min no/ /sems dben gyi rim pa'i skabs/ rdul chos gyi thig le/ rags 'bring tha gsum brtan pas/ bde stong gi nyams myong rkyen gyis mi 'phrog pa thob pas snang mched thob gsum gyi sa thob/ bzhi pa don gyi 'od gsal gyi sa dngos su da lta ma thob kyang*/ nyer thob skad cig ma bzhi pa 'od gsal rjes mthun pa'i sa thob bo/ /sa de rnams kyi rgyun sgyu lus kyi rim pa'i skabs su gnas shing gong 'phel du 'gyur la/ 'od gsal gyi rim pa'i skabs ni/ rang bzhin brgyad cu mngon 'gyur pa gtan nas 'gags shing*/

de'i rgyu las sems dben gyi sa rnams kyis bskrun par mi nus pa'i snang gsum gyi sa yang thob cing*/ mthar skad cig bzhi pa 'od gsal gyi sa dngos de thob bo/ /bzhi pa ni/ rtags dang rtags can 'char tshul ni/ /ye shes 'char dang rdzogs pa'i dus/ /rlung sems tsam las byung ba yi/ /sgyu ma'i lus ni snang bar bcas/ /zhes pa ste/ gong du bshad pa'i rtag rim pa lnga po de la/ rags pa nyer lnga thim pa'i rtags rnams zhib mor shes dgos/ rtags can gyi shes pa ni/ dang po'i skabs bde sdug sna tshogs pa'i nyams dang*/ phyi ma bzhi spyir bde stong gi nyams su 'dra yang shas che chung gi dbang du byas na/ snang ba bde ba/ mched pa gsal ba/ thob pa mi rtog pa/ 'od gsal ni thams cad cha mnyam pa'o// 'char ba'i tshul de lta bus rim pas bskyed rim nas brtsams te/ sems dben gyi thob pa'i sa'i bar du yang dang yang du ye shes gsum rim pas rgyud la 'char ba dang*/ mthar phra rags thim tshul rdzogs par shar ba'i sems dben mthar thug pa'i 'od gsal byung ba'i dus na/ de las langs ma thag pa'i snang gsum lugs zlog gi mthar bde bas byin gyis brlabs pa'i rlung sems tsam las byung zhing*/ rlung sems las grub pa'i sgyu ma'i lus te ye shes gyi sku 'bar ba'i snang ba dang bcas te 'byung zhing*/ rdzu 'phrul sogs thun mong gi yon tan dpag tu med pa'o/ /lnga pa ni/ 'od gsal rgyun gyi bsam gtan gyis/ las dang sgrib pa bag chags sbyangs/ /zhes te/ 'od gsal gyi rim pa la/ chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor/ ril por 'dzin pa dang*/ rjes su gzhig pa'i bsam gtan bsgom pa'i stobs kyis mi dge ba'i lus kyi sa bon bde ba dang*/ sgrib pa ste nyon mongs mngon gyur ye shes su gnas 'gyur ba dang*/ rang bzhin brgyad cu'i bag chags te sa bon rnams sbyangs bas dag pa'o/ /yang na sgrib pa ni rnam smin gyi lus la yang 'chad du rung ngo*/

/drug pa ni/ sa lam rtags kyi rim pa'i tshogs/ 'di nyid thob pas myur du 'char/ /zhes pa ste/ sa dang lam ni skabs 'dir don gcig la/ 'phags pa'i sa bcu'am bcu gnyis kyi lam rtags yon tan brgya phrag bcu la sogs pa'i rim pa'i tshogs rnams dang*/ ji skad du/ kun tu 'od kyi sa chen po/ /de nyid nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dra/ /zhes sogs/ thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan gyi rtags rnams kyang*/ rim pa 'di nyid thob pas myur du 'char bar 'gyur ro/ / zhes pa ste/ 'od gsal gyi rim pa'i mthar thug pa/ don gyi 'od gsal skyes pa na/ de ma thag tu zung 'jug gi sku 'grub pas/ yon tan de dag rim gyis 'char ba'i don yin pas/ 'di nyid ces pa'i tshig gi bsnyeg 'tshams 'od gsal zhes pa las gzhan du med do rgyas bshad rtsa ba'i don tshan gnyis pa/ slar yang gtan la dbab pa'i tshul gyis bshad pa la/ 'khor lo can gyi man ngag rgyas par bshad*/ bskyed rdzogs spyi'i bsgom tshul gsal bar bstan rnam gzhag gzhan rnams kyang de la tshang tshul/ don chen thor bu ba sna tshogs pa bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam par bya/ /'dab ma brgyad pa'i 'khor lo la/ /dbus su srog gi sa bon te/ /yi ge ka nas hā yi bar/ /k+ṣa ni spangs pa bzhi bcas pa/ / dbyangs ni phyi rim snang ba ste/ /gsal byed bar ma mched pa nyid/ /ma ning snang ba thod par brjod/ /bcu gnyis yi ge thig ler bcas/ /'greng ba lta bur gnas pa ni/ /rim pa lnga ldan bsam par bya/ /'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs pa/ /e baṃ thabs dang shes rab las/ /sdud cing spro bar mdzad pa yi/ / a zhes dbus su gnas par mdzad/ /mnyam pa nyid du sems bsdams te// mnyam bzhag 'khor lo'i lte ba yis/ /ye shes mnyam par mthong 'gyur ba/ /nye bar thob pa stong pa che/ /'od gsal ba yi gnas thob pas/ /'khor ba las ni rgal bar 'gyur/

/thun gcig gam ni nyin gcig gi /zla phyed zla ba lo yi dus// bskal pa'i bskal pa stong du yang*/ /skad cig re res gnas pa ni/ /ye shes sbyor ba rtag tu 'byung*/ /zhes pa'o/ /nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor te rtsa a wa dhā tā'i nang gi dbus su gnas par/ gsal ba mi gshigs pa'i thig le'i dkyil 'khor bsam par bya'o/ /zhes te/ 'di ni rtsa rgyud las/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ zhes le'u drug pa las gsungs pa des gdams ngag 'di ston to zhes pa'i don te/ 'khor lo can dang 'khor lo med pa dang sems dpa' gsum brtsegs sogs mi shigs pa'i thig le bsgom pa thams cad ston par 'gyur zhing*/ der ma zad gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor zla ba'i ming yin/ de byang chub kyi sems thig le'i brda tshig yin pas/ gtum mo 'bar bas haṃ yig zhu ba'ang bstan par 'gyur ro/ /skabs 'dir sngags 'khor dngos ni rgyud phyi ma las/ rang sngags snying gar bsams nas ni/ /srog ni thig ler gyur bar bzhag /ces pas bstan par bzhed de/ 'dab ma brgyad pa'i 'khor lo gsum rim la/ lte ba rtsa dbu ma'i dbus su srog gi rlung dwangs ma dang 'dres pa'i mi shigs thig le sa bon a yig dang bcas pa ste/ phyi rim gyi 'dab ma brgyad la/ dbyangs yig bcu gnyis phyogs su gnyis gnyis dang*/ mtshams su re re'o/ /yang dgongs pa lung ston las/ cha la sogs pa bcu drug gnas/ /zhes pa'i 'di bstan par bzhed pa ltar na/ dbyangs bcu drug tshang ba dgos par gsal yang*/ ma ning bzhi po gzhan du 'god pas 'dir mi 'god pa bla ma'i man ngag go /de lta bu'i pad 'dab dang yi ge dkar po la sems bzung bas/ gsal snang thob pa na snang ba'i nyams myong skye bar 'gyur te/ slar rim pas snang ba'i sa thob par 'gyur ba'i rgyu thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /'dab brgyad bar ma la gsal byed de/ yi ge ka nas ha'i bar yod la/

k+ṣa yig spangs shing lce rtsa can gnyis dang*/ mchu can gnyis te bzhi bsnan pa'o/ /de ltar na/ sde pa lnga la lnga tshan lnga dang mthar gnas dang*/ dro ba dang*/ lce mchu can rnams la bzhi bzhi ste/ sde tshan brgyad la gsal byed so bdun no/ /de yang lung ston las/ lnga pa lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /bzhi ni gsum du nges par sbyar/ /zhes pa'i don yin gsung*/ tsa yig de dag kha dog dmar po la gsal snang thob na mched pa'i ye shes skye zhing rim pas de'i sa thob bo// gser sdings pa'i yig chung rnams na/ 'khor lo rim pa gnyis po 'di'i yi ge rnams 'di dang go bzlog tu bshad de/ phan tshun rgyas btab yin pas mi 'gal gsung ngo*/ /'dab brgyad nang ma la/ ma ning gi dbyangs yig bzhi po kha dog mthing ga bsgom ste/ gsal snang thob na snang ba thob pa'i ye shes skye zhing*/ rim pas de'i sa thob bo/ /phyi skor gyi dbyangs kyi yi ge bcu gnyis po 'di/ zla phyed thig le nā dar bcas pa 'phreng ba lta bu ste/ gral snyoms par gnas pa bsgom pa'o zhes 'chad la/ yang na 'phreng ba lta bu ni/ man ngag gzhan las 'byung ba ltar/ rlung 'gro 'ong dang lhan cig dbyangs kyi yig 'bru spro bsdu byed pa'i don yang yin par sems mod/ mar lugs kyi man ngag yig chung rnams na gsal bar 'dug pa ma mthong zhing ma thos so/ /sngags 'khor de bsgoms nas/ rim pa lnga ldan du bsam par bya ba ni/ rim lnga gdan rdzogs sam/ stan thog gcig ma zhes bya'o/ /stan thog gcig ma zhes bya ba'i tha snyad/ rgyud gzhung las mi 'byung bas/ de'i don ngos 'dzin pa la man ngag tshad ma yin no/ /de yi dbang du byas na/ lus dben sogs rim pa drug gi rnal 'byor rnams/ lo zla mang po'i dus/ snga phyir dmigs pa so sor bkram ste bsgoms pas/ stan thog gcig tu rdzogs par mi 'gyur gyi/ thun gcig gi nang du dmigs chen gcig la/ rim pa drug gam lnga car gyi nyams len tshang na/

gdan thog gcig tu rdzogs pa zhes bya'o/ /de yang lus dben gyi lha dngos thob na rab/ de min na rjes mthun pa'am/ bskyed rim gyi lha la lus dben du mos pa tsam byas pas rung ste/ de'i thugs kar bshad ma thag pa'i sngags kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par bsgom mo/ /sngar bskyed rim la myong ba thon pa'am/ dbang po rnon po yin na/ bskyed rim ma bsgoms kyang*/ sngags 'khor bsgoms pa gcig pus kyang*/ bskyed rim dang lus dben gyi dod thub pa zhig mar lugs pa rnams bzhed de/ 'khor lo bzhi'i rtsa yig bsgoms pas ral gri la sogs pa'i dngos grub brgyad thob par kha sbyor las gsungs pa dang phyogs 'dra'o/ /de nas a wa dhā tī'i khong stong gtso bor gyur pa'i rtsa 'khor gyi sbubs la e shes rab ces bya/ de dag la gnas pa'i yig 'bru rnams baṃ yig thabs zhes brjod pa las/ skabs 'dir snying ga'i 'khor lo'i lte ba rtsa dbu ma'i rtsa mdud kyi nang du mi shigs pa'i thig le gnas pa las/ dbugs dbyung ba dang*/ hūṃ gis spro bar mdzad cing*/ nang du 'ong pa dang*/ oṃ gyis sdud par byed/ āḥzhes pas thig le'i dbus su hūṃ gnas par mdzad do/ /de n-i rdor bzlas kyi rim pa'i rnal 'byor te rtsa lam sbyang ba'o/ /de nas rlung mnyam pa nyid du bum can kha sbyor du bzang zhing sems kyang rnam rtog gzhan bsdams te/ 'khor lo'i dmigs pa la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag par bya'o/ /bar 'dir sems gsum gyi dmigs pa 'jug rgyu yin/ nyer thob bzhi pa'i don du 'khor lo'i lte ba'i mi shigs pa'i thig le la mnyam par bzhag pas/ ye shes gang zhig rdzogs rim gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i/ bde gsal stong pa ro mnyam par shar ba/ mthong zhing myong bar 'gyur ba ni/ snang ba gsum las snang ba nye bar thob pa khyad par can no/ /stong pa gsum las stong pa chen po mthar thug pa/ skad cig bzhi pa'i nyer thob bam/

yang na snang gsum las 'das pa'i skad cig bzhi pa'i 'od gsal gyi gnas thob par 'gyur ro/ /de las ye shes sbyor ba ste/ sems bde stong dang*/ lus lha sku'i gsal snang dus gcig tu mnyam par sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin 'byung ste/ de yang rtag tu zhes pa/ rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad pa'i don ma yin/ lan ji tsam 'od gsal du zhugs pa de tsam gyi rjes thams cad du/ lha sku de nges par 'byung*/ rtag par 'byung zhes pa'o/ /de yang las dang po pas ni 'khor lo phyi ma la sems brtad de yun ring bar bzhag snang ba'i ye shes skyes par bsgom/ thun chung re 'jog khar/ de bar pa la thim/ mched pa dang*/ de nang ma la thim/ thob pa dang*/ de thig le la thim/ thob pa skad cig ma bzhi pa skyes par bsgom/ der mi rtog pa la bzhag nas de sad pa na lha skur bsgom ste/ sgyu lus dngos su mos pa byed/ yang rjes gzhig gi rim pas bsdus te don gyi 'od gsal du mos/ yang lhar skyes te zung 'jug tu mos pa byed do/ /yang na stong par 'jug ldang lan gnyis mi byed par/ sems dmigs dang 'od gsal rnam pa 'dra bas/ snang bzhi'i sdud rim gcig po de la/ sems dben gyi rim pa dang 'od gsal gyi rim pa gnyis kar mos pa nyis sbrag bya/ sgyu lus dang*/ zung 'jug kyang yod lugs 'dra bas lha skur langs thengs gcig po de la mos pa gnyis ka bya'o/ /de ltar bsgoms pas da lta rim pa lnga'i sa lam rgyud la skyes pa ga la zhig rgyu'i ye shes kyang dngos su shar ba min mod/ rdo rje lus la gnad du bsnun pa ni yin zhing*/ bskyed rim gyi sku gsum mos pa lam byed sogs dang 'dra bar/ /rim pa lnga'i ye shes dang*/ sa lam de rnams myur du rgyud la skye ba'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu rten 'brel sgrig phyogs bla na med pa yin pas/ rim pa lnga stan thog gcig tu rdzogs par bya zhes bya'o/ /de nas kyang dmigs pa de nyid bsgoms pa dang*/

rtsa lam byang ba dang*/ snang bzhi'i nyams dang*/ lha sku'i gsal snang cung zad tsam rim gyis rim gyis skye zhing*/ go rim ni gcig tu nges pa yang med do/ /de'i tshe/ bde stong dang lha sku de dngos su na/ lus dben nam/ ngag dben gyi rim pa gang rung yin yang*/ rim pa gzhan rnams la'ang rjes mthun pa'i nyams myong skyes rjes mthun pa'i ye shes shar ba yin pas/ rim lnga'i nyams myong stan thog gcig tu rdzogs pa zhes bya'o/ /de ltar ma go bas/ mkhas rmongs so so la za zi langs lugs mi 'dra ba du ma byung ngo*/ /de ltar bsgoms pa'i phan yon ni/ don gyi 'od gsal thob na 'khor ba so sor skye bo'i sa las ni rgal zhing*/ 'phags pa'i gnas pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyir rdzogs rim gyi ye shes bde stong dang lha skur rang shar rgyud la skyes pa nas gzung ste dang por thun gcig 'khyongs ba 'byung la/ de nas rim pas nyin gcig gam/ zla ba phyed dang*/ zla ba gcig dang*/ lo'i dus kyi bar du yang bsgom dgos shing*/ sgyu lus kyi sku dngos thob nas ni bskal pa gcig gam/ bskal pa stong gi bar du yang rung ste/ de ltar ngang gis gnas kyang gnas la/ 'khor 'das kun na de las lhag pa'i don gzhan med pas/ rgyun bsrings te bsgom dgos kyang dgos so/ /de yang rlung dbu mar thim pa'i bde stong gi ye shes bya rdzogs kyi skad cig ma re rer gnas pa las/ nam zhig langs pa'i tshe lha sku rang shar re re 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar 'khor lo can la rgyas bshad mdzad pa ni/ rim lnga stan thog gcig ma 'khor lo can 'di la go ba shar na/ 'khor lo med pa sogs gzhan rnams shugs la go ba'i dbang du mdzad pa'o/ /gnyis pa bskyed rdzogs spyi'i bsgom tshul gsal bar bstan pa la/ bstan bshad gnyis kyi dang po ni/ rim pa gnyis po la gnas pa/ mnyam par zung 'brel nyid du bsgom/ /zhes ste/ 'dis ni gnyis po la nyams myong ma skyes bar du/

thun stod la bskyed rim dang*/ thun smad la rdzogs rim sgom pa'am/ thun dang po la bskyed rim dang*/ gnyis pa la rdzogs rim bsgom pa lta bu'i zung 'brel yang bstan/ gnyis ka la nyams myong cung zad shar na/ phan tshun du rgyas 'debs shing*/ gang rung gcig kho na la nyams myong shar na/ des cig shos la rgyas 'debs pa'i zung 'jug gi tshul du sgrub pa yang bstan to/ /spyir yang zung 'brel la zung 'jug gis ma khyab/ zung 'jug la zung 'brel gyis khyab bo zhes pa'ang go bar bya'o/ /lar skabs 'dir rim lnga las/ bskyed pa'i rim la legs gnas shing*/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'dod rnams la/ /thabs 'di rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /skas kyi rim pa lta bur gsungs/ /zhes pa'i don la nges pa rnyed dgos so/ /gnyis pa rgyas bshad la/ bskyed rim/ lus dben/ ngag dben/ sems dben/ bdag byin rlabs mngon par byang chub/ mi gnas pa'i myang 'das kyi rim pa ste bdun las/ dang po ni/ bskyed pa'i rim ste lha yi sku/ / rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi dkyil 'khor mchog /rnam pa mngon du byed pa gang*// legs par bslabs pas mthar phyin 'gyur/ /zhes te/ rim pa gnyis las bskyed pa'i rim pa 'di ni/ ngo bo lha sku la gsal snang du shar ba'i ting nge 'dzin te/ bsgom bya rgyal ba rigs lnga la sogs pa/ dkyil 'khor kyi 'khor lo mchog de dag rnam pa ni gsal snang mngon sum du byed pa gang yin pa ste/ man ngag bzhin du lha sku'i gsal snang dang*/ lha'i nga rgyal dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rim pa rnams la legs par bslabs pas dbang po rno na lo gcig tsam gyis mthar phyin par 'gyur te/ mthar phyin pa'i tshad ni/ reg pa dang mthong ba'i tshad ma rnyed pa'o/ /bskyed rim da lta blos gsal 'debs pa ni/ rgyu tsam yin la goms nas gsal snang shar na ni/ bskyed rim dngos su 'gyur te ye shes kyi ming can no/ / de yang ngo bo dkyil 'khor gsal snang rtog med dang*/

nga rgyal dang rtsol ba rtog bcas gnyis 'dus yin zhing*/ rgyu ni snga rol nas rtog pa goms pa las byung ba/ rnam pa mar la 'khor ba'i 'chi bar skye gsum dang mthun/ yar la sangs rgyas kyi sku gsum dang mthun/ bar du rdzogs rim dang rnam pa mthun pas/ dag rdzogs smin gsum lam du byed pa/ grogs rtsol bcas kyi bde ba dang stong pas brgyan pa cig la bskyed rim dngos zer/ mtshan nyid de rnams ma tshang ba'i lha bsgom sngags bzlas ni/ bskyed rim dngos ma yin rjes mthun pa'o/ /dbye na rags pa la sems zin pa dran pa gcig pa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ phra ba la sems zin pa rtog pa'i rnal 'byor gnyis yod/ dkyil 'khor rgyas bsdus kyi dbye ba dang rnal 'byor bzhi dang*/ ting 'dzin gsum dang*/ yan lag drug la sogs pa'i dbye ba rgyas par shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ lus dben snang ba sems dang lus/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu 'jig rten bcas/ /rim pas lha yi bdag nyid sbyor/ /rdo rje 'chang chen lam du byed// mos pa las byung ting nge 'dzin/ /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'o/ /zhes te/ lus rnam par dben pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ sems tshor ba sogs phung po bzhi dang*/ yid kyi dbang po sogs dang*/ lus gzugs phung dang*/ dbang po lnga dang*/ yul lnga ste/ lus sems de dag ni rgyu ba nang sems can gyis bsdus pa dang*/ 'byung ba bzhi ni phyi nang gnyis ka dang*/ yul lnga ni mi rgyu ba phyis bsdus yin pa las/ phyi'i 'byung ba bzhi ni mi rgyu ba snod dang*/ nang gi 'byung ba bzhi ni sems can gyi lus so/ /de ltar na/ phung po lnga/ 'byung ba bzhi/ dbang po lnga/ yul lnga dang ye shes sam/ yang na yid rnams la lnga lngar phye ba/ snod kyi 'jig rten dang bcas pa'i 'khor ba'i snang ba/ dbye ba brgya phrag gcig po 'di dag re re bzhin rim pas dam pa rigs brgyas bsdus pa'i lha'i bdag nyid du sbyor zhing*/ de la goms nas rigs lnga dang*/

rigs gsum gyi dbye ba la bslab/ mthar gsang chen rigs gcig tu 'gyur ba yin yang*/ lus dben gyi rim pa'i skabs 'dir/ rigs brgya rdzogs sam ma rdzogs kyang rung ste/ rigs brgyar gtogs pa'i lhar snang gi ting nge 'dzin cig dngos su thob par byas nas/ rgyal ba rigs lnga ste ye shes lnga'i rjes btab dang*/ gsang ba rigs gsum ste rdo rje gsum gyi rgyas btab dang*/ gsang chen rigs gcig ste rdo rje 'chang chen bde ba chen po'i rgyas btab rnams/ da lta dngos su ma thob mod/ mos pa las byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi lam du byed cing*/ de ltar mos pas rigs brgya dang rigs gcig gi bar de dag gi go 'phang mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel legs par bsgrib pa'o/ / 'dir phung khams rigs brgya ni/ phung po lnga/ 'byung ba bzhi/ dbang po lnga/ yul lnga rnams la lnga lngar phye bas/ dgu bcu go lnga yod/ de'i steng du yid lnga'am ye shes lnga ste/ lnga tshan gnyis po gang rung gcig dkyus su bcug pas brgya tham pa 'ong*/ lnga tshan cig shos de spyi khyab tu btang ngo/ /dam pa rigs brgya ni/ rgyal ba rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' lnga/ rdo rje ma lnga rnams la re re bzhin rigs lngas phye bas dgu bcu go lnga byung*/ ye shes lnga'i dbang du byas nas/ rgyal ba rigs lnga spyi 'gro zhig snon pa'am/ yid kyi dbang du byas nas 'jam dpal rigs lnga bsnan pas brgya tham pa'o/ /lus dben gyi ngo bo ni/ rags pa'i rlung rags pa'i dbu mar cung zad thim pa'i bde stong gi ngang las rnam rtog gis ma skyed par/ yid ngo kho nar rang shar ba'i lha sku'o/ /yang de tsam min kyang stong pa'i nyams myong cung zad bsgom pa'i ngang nas/ rtsol med du lha skur 'char tsam byung na/ lus dben rjes mthun pa yin no/ stong par mos pa'i ngang nas/ rtsol bcas kyi lha sku skyed na/ ngo bo'i sgo nas bskyed rim kho na las ma 'das kyang lus dben du mos pas/

'brel ba'i sgo nas lus dben gyi rgyu khyad par can du 'gyur ro/ /deng sang gi las dang po pa la 'khrid 'bogs pa'i tshe/ de tsam gyis lus dben gyi dmigs pa go chod par 'gyur te/ de'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/ rlung gi 'byung 'jug gnas pa gsum/ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje las/ rlung sngags mnyam par sbyor ba gang*/ /rdo rje'i bzlas pa'i rim pa'o/ /zhes te/ rlung gi rgyu ba phyir 'byung ba ni/ rlung de dang thugs kyi rdo rje'i sngags hūṃ yig mnyam par rab tu sbyor ba dang*/ rlung 'jug pa dang sku rdo rje'i sngags oṃ yig mnyam par sbyor ba dang*/ rlung gnas pa dang gsung rdo rje'i sngags āḥyig mnyam par rab tu sbyor ba rnams/ rtsa dbu ma'i rlung du gyur pa gang yin pa de ni/ ngag dben rdo rje'i bzlas pa'i rim pa'o/ /de la gong du smos pa ltar/ yi ge 'bru gsum ngag tshig dang bcas pa'ang srid mod kyi nges par dgos pa ma yin/ yi ge 'bru gsum gyi don rdo rje gsum gyi ye shes yin zhing*/ de grib ma'i tshul gyis nyams su lon na rlung gi rnal 'byor gang byas kyang*/ rdo rje gsum gyi rnal 'byor las ma 'das pas rdo rje'i bzlas pa'o/ /de la dbye na gsum/ gdong gi sna rtser 'od kyi thig le sgom pa zhes bya ba rtsa ba'i rlung dang yan lag gi rlung la/ rtsa lam sbyong ba'i rdor bzlas byed pa dang*/ snying ga'i sna rtser mi shigs pa'i thig le sgom pa zhes pa/ snying ga gtso bor gyur pa'i rtsa 'khor rnams su/ yig 'bru'am thig le sogs la sems bzung bas/ rlung dang thig le dhū tīr 'ching ba dang gsang ba'i sna rtser rdzas kyi thig le sgom pa zhes bya ba/ las sam ye shes kyi phyag rgya bsten pas/ rlung sems dbu mar zhugs gnas thim gsum byed pa ste gsum mo/ /'dir rdzas zhes pa thig le kun da lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems yin la/

de nyid gsang ba'i sna rtser bsgom zhes gsungs pas/ 'khor lo bzhi la lugs 'byung lugs zlog yin te/ rdo rje 'phreng bar yang de la rgyas bshad mdzad pas/ gang dag 'phags skor gyi lugs la/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams kyi rtsa gnas nas byang chub kyi sems zhu ba snying gar 'du ba kho na yin gyi/ 'khor lo bzhi la 'gro 'ong byed pa min zhes 'chad pa ni mi 'thad de/ snying ga 'ba' zhig tu bsdus pa la/ gsang ba'i sna rtser bsgom pa'i tha snyad mi 'thad pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ gsang sngags las byung rnam par shes/ snang ba gsum gyi bdag nyid ni/ ye shes 'byung zlog nges pa gang*/ sems la dmigs pa'i rim pa'o/ /gsang sngags te rlung rnams rdo rje gsum gyi ye shes su gyur pa de nyid goms pa las/ 'bar 'dzag gi ye shes bde stong lhan cig skyes pa 'byung la/ de ni rnam par shes pa ste snang ba gsum gyi bdag nyid kyi ye shes 'jug pa ste/ snang ba thim nas mched pa shar/ de thim nas thob pa tsam po shar/ de thim nas thob pa khyad par can dpe'i 'od gsal la ring du mnyam par 'jog go / zlog pa ni/ thob pa khyad par can de las langs nas/ thob pa phal pa skye/ de las snang ba skye/ de las sa sogs 'byung bzhi'am khams lnga skye bas rnam rtog phal pa 'byung ngo de lta bu'i 'jug ldog nges pa gang zhig rtag tu sgom pa ni/ sems la dmigs pa'i rim pa'o/ /'dir nges dgos pa ni/ snang ba bzhi dang*/ dga' ba bzhi don gcig ste/ snang ba dga' ba/ mched pa mchog dga' thob pa khyad dga'/ sems dben gyi rim pa'i skabs/ nyer thob skad cig bzhi pa dang*/ 'od gsal gyi rim pa la zhugs nas/ skad cig bzhi pa 'od gsal rang ste/ de gnyis ni lhan cig skyes dga' 'o/ /'on kyang lugs zlog gi tshe/ don gcig kyang ming mi 'dra ste/ thob pa la dga' ba mchog dga' gnyis dang*/ mched pa khyad dga' dang*/ snang ba lhan skyes so/ /sems dben rang gi ngo bo ni/

rnam rtog gi bzhon pa'i rlung rnams sgom stobs kyis rtsa 'khor rnams kyi lte bar thim pas thig le brtan par gyur pa'i bde stong gi ye shes yin la/ de sgrub par byed pa'i thabs ni/ rang lus gzhan lus gnyis kas las byed cing*/ rim lnga las/ 'dod chags nyid dang chags bral dang*/ /de yi bar te gsum po ni/ /dbang po gnyis ni mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rdo rje pad+ma 'dus las so/ /zhes sems dben gyi sgrub pa las rgya nyid gtso bor gsungs pa lta bur yod kyang*/ zhib mor na/ snang ba'i sa/ mched pa'i sa/ thob pa tsam po'i sa rnams steng sgo 'ba' zhig gis kyang sgrub tu rung la/ nyer thob bzhi pa'i sa thob pa ni/ nges par phyi rol gyi phyag rgya la rag las pa'o// zhes pa'ang spyir btang la nges pa yin no/ /snang gsum lugs zlog ni snga phyi gong 'og thams cad du 'byung mod kyi/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa'i rim pa man chad la lus ma rdzogs pa dang*/ rgyu lus kyi rim pa yan chad la/ gsar thob ma yin pa'i phyir ma smos la/ 'dir lus rdzogs pa gsar thob yin pa'i phyir smos so/ /de ltar yang*/ 'phags pas/ stong nyid shin tu stong pa dang*/ /gsum pa stong ba chen po dang*/ /bzhi pa thams cad stong pa ni/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i bye brag go /zhes lugs 'byung gi tshe gzhan gsum rgyu/ bzhi pa 'bras bu/ lugs zlog dang sbyar na/ de nyid rgyu/ gzhan gsum 'bras bu'o/ /yang skad cig ma'i snang ba bzhi dang*/ snang ba'i sa bzhi po yang dbye ba phyed pa yang gal che ste/ rim lnga'i 'grel chen du rgyas par bshad zin cing*/ cung zad 'og tu 'chad do/ /lnga pa ni/ rmi lam lus ni rnam sbyang phyir/ /sgyu mar mtshon pa'i dus gang las/ /yul snang kun rdzob gang byung ba/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i rim pa'o/ /zhes te/ de la bdag byin brlab pa'i rim pa'i ye shes ni/ rgyu 'od gsal kyi rlung sems tsam las grub pa/ rkyen dang por snang gsum gyi rim pas/

las rlung mi shigs pa la thim pa'i bde ba shar/ bde ba de slar yang snang gsum lugs zlog tu shar ba las skyes pa'o/ /rnam pa ni gtso bo med du mi rung ba/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang*/ zhar byung dag ma dag gi snang ba sna tshogs dang bcas pa/ byed las rnal 'byor pa'i rang snang du lus kyi bya ba byed nus dang*/ nyams kyi khyad par gnas lugs mtshon par nus pa'i zhu bde'i bde stong gis khyab pa ste/ khyad par lnga lngan de ni/ bdag byin brlab pa'i mtshan nyid yin pa las/ mnyam bzhag sgyu lus la mtshan nyid thams cad gsal bar rdzogs pa yin zhing rjes thob sgyu lus la ni thams cad tshang bar gcig tu nges pa yang ma yin no/ /rim lnga las/ de nyid rlung dang yang dag ldan/ /rnam shes gsum po slar yang ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yi lus su 'gyur*/ /sgyu ma'i lus zhes de la bshad/ /ces mnyam bzhag sgyu lus kyi gtso bo dang*/ de bas 'di ltar 'gro ba kun/ /sgyu ma lta bur 'dir bshad de// sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gnas/ /thams cad de dang 'dra bar mthong*/ /zhes mnyam bzhag sgyu lus kyi yan lag ye shes kyi sku shes bya la spro ba dang*/ rjes thob sgyu ma yang bstan to/ /sgyu ma'i sku la dpe bcu gnyis yod pa las/ dpe'i gtso bo gsum ni/ me long nang gi gzugs brnyan gyis/ /sgyu ma'i lus ni mtshon par bya/ kha dog rnams ni 'ja' lta bu/ khyab pa chu yi zla bas so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /spyir rnal 'byor pas ni gang gang dmigs/ /de de sgyu ma bzhin du brtag /ces snang ni snang yang bden ni mi bden pa sgyu ma lta bur rtogs pa zhig mnyam rjes kun tu dgos pa yin mod kyang*/ 'dir dpe 'di rnams bden med rkyang pa la mi sbyor te/ ye shes kyi sku'i mtshan nyid so so la sbyor ro/ /de yang*/ me long gi gzugs brnyan skad cig la rdzogs pa ltar/ /sku'am dkyil 'khor yang skad cig gis rdzogs pa dang*/ me long dwangs pa la gzugs brnyan shar/

shar ba'i dus na yang me long las ma 'das pa ltar/ bde stong lhan skyes las lha skur shar zhing shar zin pa'i dus na yang bde stong gi nyams dang ma bral ba'o/ /'ja' tshon ni chu zil dang*/ 'od las kha dog gsal bar snang ba ltar/ 'byung lus rags pa med kyang rlung sems phra mo las dbyibs dang kha dog ma 'dres par yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /'byung lus rags pa med kyang phra mo ni yod do/ /chu zla lta bu ni zla ba gcig shar chu klung kun la yongs su khyab pa ltar ye shes kyi sku gcig nyid snang ba sna tshogs pa la spro bar nus pa'o/ /de ltar go bar byas te rmi lam gyi lus kyis mtshon pa/ bar do la sogs pa gsal snang gi lus thams cad/ rnam par dag cing sbyong ba'i phyir/ lam 'di bsgom dgos pa ste/ sgyu lus kyi sbyang bya phra mo'i snang ba la zhen pa ste/ de rmi lam dang bar do'i thabs la brten nas sbyong zhes pa'o/ /ji skad du/ kun rdzob bden pa sgyu ma nyid/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yang de/ /de nyid dri za'i sems can gyur/ /rdo rje'i sku yang de nyid yin/ /zhes so/ /man ngag pa snga ma rnams/ sgyu lus kyi sbyang gzhi rmi lam zhes zer ba yang de la bsams shing*/ rmi lam longs sku'i dang bar do longs sku tha snyad kyang 'di dag la brten no/ /rmi lam du lha sku bden med sgyu ma lta bur shar bas rkyen byas te sad dus kyi snang ba thams cad sgyu mar mtshon nus pa'i dus der mnyam bzhag tu snang stong sgyu ma tsam shar ba na/ rjes thob tu yul snang kun kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bur rtogs pa gang zhig 'byung ba de ni/ sgyu ma lta bu ste sgyu lus kyi rim pa'i man ngag go /gzhung chung 'dir rtags dang rtags can zhes sogs kyi skabs/ ye shes kyi sku'i mtshan nyid bshad zin pas skabs 'dir ni/ las dang po pa nyid kyi sgom tshul/ sgyu lus kyi sgrub pa nyams len gsal bar bstan to/ /rje btsun mar pa lho brag pa'i gdams pa rnams las/

rim lnga dang chos drug gi gdams pa rnams su/ rmi lam dang bar do'i gdams ngag rnams sgyu lus kyi yan lag tu mdzad la/ ma rgyud kyi gdams ngag 'ga' rer/ rmi lam gyi gdams ngag sgyu lus kyi rtsa bar mdzad pa yang yod de/ gzhung tshig 'dir yang de lta bu'o/ /drug pa ni/ rang bzhin shes pa'i bsam gtan las/ thabs las ma skyes ting nge 'dzin/ /rang gsal ngo bo mi rtog pa/ /'od gsal don dam rig pa'o/ /zhes te 'dir/ rang bzhin shes pa'i bsam gtan las/ /zhes pas 'od gsal gyi sgrub pa bstan/ 'od gsal don dam rim pa'o/ /zhes pas/ don gyi 'od gsal mthong lam mngon par byang chub bstan/ thabs la ma brten sogs tshig rkang bar pa gnyis kyis 'od gsal gyi rim pa'i dmigs yul rtogs bya don dam bden pa dngos chos dbyings nyid bstan to/ /'dir rtogs byed lam gyi 'od gsal la yang don dam bden pa zhes bya ste/ don dam rtogs tshul la bslu med du bya ba byed nus yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na lam 'dis dngos su rtogs par bya rgyu'i yul ni thabs te rgyu las ma byung zhing ma skyes pa'i ting nge 'dzin te rang bzhin bde ba chen po dang de nyid gdod ma nas rang gsal ba rnam par thams cad pa dang*/ rang gi ngo bo spros pa thams cad las yongs su 'das pa'i rnam par mi rtog pa'i stong nyid te dgag phyogs kyi sgo nas ma skyes pa dang*/ sgrub phyogs kyi sgo nas bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum ste/ mtshan nyid bzhi ldan du 'dir bstan to/ /gzhan ting nge 'dzin yin na thabs kyis sgrubs pa kho nar nges pa la chos dbyings 'di ni rtse gcig pa'i sems mthar thug yin pas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi mchog yin yang thabs kyis ma skyed de rang byung ngo*/ /ting nge 'dzin zhes pa ni/ sa bā dhi'i sgra las/ yang dag par kun nas 'dzin/ rtag tu 'dzin pa ste mi 'gyur bar yang 'dren pas/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba zhes pa'i don du 'gyur ba yang go dgos so/

/stong pa'i mtshan nyid ni mi rtog pa kho na te/ de yang rang rig yin gyi med dgag ben stong ma yin no/ /rim pa 'di mthar thug pa na gnas lugs de mngon sum du rtogs pa yin la/ de'i sgrub pa ni/ rang bzhin gnas lugs de la gsal bar dmigs shing shes nus pa'i bsam gtan gnyis kyis sgrub par byed do/ /de yang spyod bsdus sgron me las/ chu bo'am steng ka'i chu ni dri med dag la gong bur gnas pa ltar/ de bzhin de la rjes su gzhig pa rnal 'byor bas ni rtag tu bsam/ me long la ni rlung dag rim gyis zad pa bzhin du'ang blta bya ste/ ril por 'dzin la'ang bya ba'i rim pa de bzhin 'dir ni yang dag brtag /ces gsungs la/ rim lnga las kyang*/ man ngag thob pa'i slob ma yis/ /de nas rnal 'byor rnam gnyis bslab/ /ril por 'dzin pa'i rim pa dang*/ /de bzhin rjes su gzhig pa'o/ /zhes sogs gsal bar gsungs te/ las dang po pas rnam pa lam byed du bskyed rim gyi dmigs pas bsgom pa'i tshe ni/ 'od zer spro bsdu sogs kyi rkyen las/ rang lus 'ba' zhig stong par bsdu ba ril 'dzin dang*/ snod bcud thams cad mtha' nas dbus su rim gyis bsdu ba rjes gzhig tu grags pa ltar yin la/ 'od gsal gyi rim pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas ni/ de 'dra bsgom mi dgos/ de'i mtshon don bsgom pa yin pas gtso bor rang gi lus dang*/ gzhan yang gdong thug tu gang snang ba de la/ bde stong gis rgyas btab pas snang ba de ni de 'phral dus gcig tu nub nas stong par thim pa ste/ de ni ril por 'dzin pa yin la/ snang ba rgya bskyed pa thams cad la bde stong gis rgyas btab ste bsgom na/ 'di dmigs yul rgya che bas/ dus gcig tu stong par thim mi 'gro bar/ rim pas thim 'gro ba ni rjes su gzhig pa'o/ /rim pa thim tshul gnyis te/ yul snang ba thams cad kyi steng du gcig car/ stong nyams je che la stong par thim 'gro ba gcig dang*/

yul dngos po gcig dang por thim phyis gzhan rim pas thim 'gro ba gcig go /lam 'od gsal gyi rim pa'i ngo bo ni lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba chen pos stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs par byed pa'i lam yin la/ rgyu ni snang ba bzhi'i rim pas 'jug pa dang*/ yul ni/ bdag byin brlab pa'i rim gyis ni/ /'od gsal ba ni thob par 'gyur/ /zhes ye shes kyi sku la gtso bor dmigs te sgom pa yin/ byed las ni rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam rtog rlung dang bcas pa'i sa bon 'joms pa'am/ 'joms pa la phyogs pa'o/ /rim pa 'di'i mthar phyi nang gi mngon byang las/ don gyi 'od gsal thob par 'gyur ro/ /mngon byang ni/ rim lnga las/ mtshan mo snang ba'i cha ste gsal ba nyi ma'i zer 'gyed snang ba mched pa yin/ /mtshams ni snang ba thob pa rang gi rang bzhin rnams kyis lan gcig min par 'gro/ /mtshan min nyin par ma yin mtshams min gang zhig rang bzhin rnams dang gang bral ba/ /de ni byang chub skad cig yin par bla ma mchog bshad rnal 'byor pa nyid yul/ / mtshams kyi mtha' ni 'jig min mun nag tshogs ni ma lus gang du 'das pa dang*/ /ji srid nyi ma ma shar skad cig 'dir ni dri med yang dag mtha' ru bshad/ /slob dpon mchog ni rab rib bral bas slob ma la ni phyi rol byang chub bstan/ /nang gi bde ba rnyog bral sangs rgyas byang chub skad cig dag gis thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar nye rgyu rig brtul gyi dang der rdo rje slob dpon nam sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku gzhan gyis dbang bskur bas don kyi 'od gsal mthong lam thob pa des/ 'od gsal gyi rim pa rdzogs so/ /bdun pa ni/ bsam gtan mes sbyangs lha yi sku/ /rang byung ye shes dag pa'i lus/ /sbyang gzhi sbyong byed bral bar gnas/ /zung tu 'jug pa'i rim pa'o// zhes te/ sngar sgyu lus kyi rim pa'i skabs ma dag pa'i sgyu lus rang bzhin brgyad cu dang*/

snang ba gsum gyi dri mar bcas pa de/ 'od gsal gyi rim par bsam gtan gnyis kyi mes sbyangs pas/ spang bya dri ma de rnams sa bon dang bcas pa spangs shing*/ sngar gyi sku de'i ye shes kyi cha'i rgyun de zung 'jug gi lha'i skur 'gyur bas/ rang byung gdod ma'i ye shes kyi sku mthong spangs dang nyon sgrib spangs pas dag pa'i sgyu lus slob pa'i zung 'jug de/ don gyi 'od gsal thob pa'i rjes thogs bar ma chad par 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /ji skad du/ gzugs bcas 'od zer de dang de/ /rnam shes rlung dang ldan pa yis/ /bdag byin brlab pa'i rim gyis kyang*/ /sems can don du'ang lan 'ga' 'byung*/ /ji ltar dwangs ba'i chu klung las/ /nya dag rab tu ldang ba ltar/ /de bzhin thams cad stong gsal las/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes bshad pa ltar/ sngar 'od gsal gyi rim pa'i skabs su ldang 'jug de bzhin goms pa las/ 'dir 'od gsal gyi rim pa las ngang gis langs nas/ zung 'jug dbang phyug brgyad dang ldan pa rtsol med du 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /zung 'jug thog mar 'grub pa'i sa mtshams ni mnyam bzhag yin gyi/ rjes thob tu 'dod pa ni nor ba'o/ /sgom stobs kyi lam gang la rang rang gi rigs mthun gyi mnyam bzhag sngon du song nas rjes thob 'byung ba yin gyi/ rjes thob sngon la yod pa don la mi srid par ma zad/ ming tsam gyi sgo nas kyang*/ rang gis rang nyid sun phyung ba'o/ /yang 'od gsal mnyam bzhag yin zhing*/ 'di de'i rjes thob yin pas mi 'gal snyam na/ 'od gsal gyi rim pa'i mnyam bzhag gi mthar/ rjes thob yong na/ rim pa de nyid kyi rjes thob 'ong ba 'thad kyi/ zung 'jug gi rim pa'i rjes thob ga la 'ong*/ des na zung 'jug kyang yin la/ rjes thob kyang yin pa zhig yod na/ de'i sngon du zung 'jug kyang yin la mnyam bzhag kyang yin pa zhig nges par 'gro dgos so// mi slob pa'i zung 'jug ni/

sbyang gzhi chos nyid dang*/ sbyong byed lam gyi dbye ba dang bral ba ste/ rtogs bya rtogs byed/ yul yul can gyi dbye ba med par rtag tu gnas pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ste/ 'dir yang thugs chos sku dang sku longs sku zung 'jug ces tha snyad byed de/ sku dang thugs ngo bo tha dad gtan nas med do/ /rim pa lnga las zung 'jug pa'i rim pa'o/ /'dir zung 'jug gi mtshan nyid rnam grangs mang du bshad kyang*/ ji skad du/ de nyid shes par rim shes nas/ /bdag byin brlab dang 'od gsal ba/ /de nyid la ni 'dus pa gang*/ /zung tu 'jug pa'i rim 'di yin/ /zhes skad dang ye shes zung 'jug bshad de/ mtshan nyid 'di gtso bo yin la/ /kun rdzob dang ni don dam dag /so so'i cha ni shes gyur nas/ /gang du yang dag 'dres gyur pa/ /zung du 'jug par de bshad do/ /zhes bden gnyis zung 'jug dang*/ gzung ba dang ni 'dzin par zhes/ rnam gnyis blo ni yod min te/ /gang du mi phyed blo yod pa/ /de ni zung 'jug ces byar bshad/ /ces zung 'jug gnyis med kyi don dang*/ de yang gzung 'dzin spangs shing ye shes yod pa la 'jog pa ni gnyis med zung 'jug ste/ mtshan nyid kyi rnam grangs 'di gnyis kyang rags bshad kyi tshe'ang nges par dgos pa'o/ /zung 'jug go 'phang la gnas pa/ slob bzhin pa yi rnal 'byor che/ /zung du 'jug pa bsgom gyur pas/ /spyod pa'ang de dang gnyis su med/ /ces pas slob pa'i zung 'jug ste/ dbye na 'phags lam gyi sa bcu'am bcu gnyis so/ /gaṅgā'i klung gi bye snyed kyi/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis 'di nyid dag /thugs chud yod med phyogs spangs pas/ /phyag rgya chen por bdag nyid grub/ /ces pa 'di mi slob pa'i zung 'jug ste/ dbye ba ni/ sku bzhi ye shes lnga/ zung 'jug rim pa la gnas nas/ /slar zhing gang la'ang mi slob bo/ /zhes pa'i mi slob ces pas mi slob pa'i zung 'jug ston pa ma yin/

zung 'jug thob nas lam rigs mi mthun la bslab mi dgos/ zhes slob mi slob kyi zung 'jug gnyis kar la 'jug go /lam gyi bogs 'byin rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa'i spros bcas spros med shin tu spros med kyi sprod pa'i rnam gzhag rnams/ spyod bsdus sgron me las shes par bya la/ zur tsam zhig 'og tu ston to/ /gsum pa rnam gzhag gzhan rnams de la tshang tshul la/ rgyud sbyang ba/ rnal 'byor bzhi/ ting nge 'dzin gsum/ bsnyen sgrub bzhi/ sbyor ba yan lag drugaphyag rgya bzhi/ gzhan yang tha snyad sna tshogs pa'i mtshon tshul la/ dang po ni/ byang chub sems ldan bla ma dang*/ /zhes te/ thog mar don 'dir pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam ma lus sam/ bla ma rten tshul yang ji lta bu snyam na/ lam bskyed rdzogs 'di dag kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems brtse ba snying rje chen po dang rtag tu ldan par sgrub dgos/ don dam byang chub kyi sems bdag med gnyis ldan gyi stong nyid du shes pas rtag tu zin dgos te/ stong nyid snying rje der lam gyi rnam grangs gzhan thams cad 'dus so/ /phyogs tsam mtshon na byams pa dang snying rje ni kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi rgyu yin/ las 'bras kyi blang dor ni dad pa yin/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa ni/ nges 'byung sgrub byed yin/ dad pa dang nges 'byung gi bsam pa yang*/ byang chub kyi sems kyi cha lag tsam yin zhing*/ byams snying rje'i rgyu rkyen tsam yin pas/ de thams cad kun rdzob byang sems su 'dus*/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims thams cad kyang las 'bras kyi blang dor du 'dus/ phung khams skye mched rten 'brel sogs mkhas par bya ba'i dngos po drug la mkhas pa thams cad dang*/ bden bzhi mi rtag la sogs bcu drug gi rnam pa sgom pa'i lam rnams kyang stong nyid du 'dus pas/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis bsgoms pas theg pa gzhan gyi lam thams cad kyang 'dir 'dus/

byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bla ma rdo rje slob dpon yin na/ rgyud las gsungs pa'i sten tshul ma nor ba dang*/ rtag tu bla ma'i mos gus kyis lam 'khrid pa yin no/ /sems bskyed dang mos gus bshad pas thun mong dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro thams cad bstan pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ lhag pa'i lha yi rnal 'byor dang*/ /shin tu rnal 'byor rnal 'byor che/ /rjes su rnal 'byor bcas pa dag /ces pa'i rjes su rnal 'byor zhes pa yan chad de/ lhag pa'i lha yi zhes pa dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam lha tshogs kyi ting nge 'dzin sgom pa ste/ rnal 'byor bzhi ma zad ting nge 'dzin gsum dang*/ yan lag bzhi rnams la'ang sbyar ro/ /skabs 'dir 'phags skor nyid dang sbyar na/ srung 'khor dang lhag mos sogs sngon 'gro tsam yin/ dngos gzhi las/ mngon byang dang po gnyis rnal 'byor/ phyi ma gsum rjes su rnal 'byor/ rdor sems longs sku sprul skur bsgyur ba dang*/ lus dkyil shin tu rnal 'byor/ sku gsung thugs byin rlabs/ sems dpa' gsum brtsegs/ rgyas btab/ rjes chags kyi mchog pa'i bar du rnal 'byor chen po'o/ /gzhung tshig 'di la rjes su rnal 'byor tha mar byung ba ni/ tshig bcad sbyor ba'i dbang tsam yin no/ /de ltar rnal 'byor bzhi'i bskyed rim ni/ phal cher gyis rdzogs rim gyi sngon du 'bad pas sgom dgos pa'ang yin mod kyi/ rdzogs rim nyid la'ang de dag tshang ste/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni rnal 'byor/ snang ba gsum ni rjes su rnal 'byor/ sgyu lus ni shin tu rnal 'byor/ 'od gsal ni rnal 'byor chen po'o/ /gsum pa ni/ sngar dwangs pa yi bcas pa dag /ces pa'i rjes su/ ting 'dzin rim par ldan pa nyid/ /ces pa ste/ de yang dang po sbyor ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang*/ las rgyal mchog ni/ ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi rim pa ste/ lugs 'di'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa zhig
