cho ga rgyas pas bsgom na/ rim pa de dang ldan par bsgom dgos so/ /des mtshon nas lha bsdus pa gtso bo yab yum tsam zhig cho ga rgyas pas bsgom na/ dang por dngos gzhi tsam zhig bsgom/ dkyil 'khor rgyas pa cho ga bsdus pas bsgom na/ skad cig gis bskyed pa dang*/ sa bon dang phyag mtshan tsam gyis bskyed nas/ cho ga lhag ma cung zad sbyar ba'o// gnyis ka bsdus pa ni/ lha re re skad cig gis bskyed pa sogs te/ bskyed chog bsdus pa 'di rnams lhag mos kyi rigs yin no/ /'dir bcas pa dag ces pa ni/ rnal 'byor bzhi ni dang po sbyor ba'i dbye ba yin pas/ ting 'dzin gsum bsgom na shugs la rnal 'byor bzhi dang bcas par 'gyur zhes pa'o/ /des na rnal 'byor bzhi po dang sbyor ba yin la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs spro ba ni dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang*/ bzlas pa dang zhu ba glus bskul dang*/ mchod bstod la sogs pa ni las rgyal mchog go de dag kyang sngar gyi 'phros la sbyar na/ zung 'jug gi man ngag tu rgyal mchog gnyis 'dus zhes kyang brjod rgyu yin la/ yang rnam pa gcig tu na/ dben gsum dang sbyor rgyu lus dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog 'od gsal zung 'jug las rgyal mchog go /bzhi pa ni/ bsnyen pa nyer sgrub sgrub pa che/ /sgrub pa'i ngo bo'i khyad par du/ /zhes pa'i ngo bo'i zhes pa yan chad de/ mngon byang dang po stong nyid la dmigs pa bsnyen pa/ de nas lus dkyil rdzogs kyi bar nyer sgrub/ de nas rjes chags kyi bar sgrub pa/ de nas dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu'i bar sgrub chen du bzhed do/ /'dir mnyam bzhag lus dben bsnyen pa/ rjes thob lus dben dang ngag dben nyer sgrub/ sems dmigs sgrub pa/ sgyu lus 'od gsal/ zung 'jug gsum sgrub chen no/ /'dir yang sgrub pa'i zhes sgrub pa ston byed rjes su byung ba yang sdeb sbyor gyi dbang las so/ /rdo rje 'phreng ba las/

rnal 'byor rjes su rnal 'byor dang*/ /shin tu rnal 'byor rnal 'byor che/ /dang po sbyor ba mdor bsdus pa'o/ /de bzhin dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog /las kyi rgyal po rnal 'byor mchog /ces gsungs pas/ dang sbyor la rnal 'byor bzhir phye nas/ dkyil 'khor rgyas pa cho ga rgyas pas bsgom pa'i tshe/ rnal 'byor bzhi dang*/ rgyal mchog gnyis te yan lag drug nyid kyis 'ching ba yin no/ /lugs 'di'i rnal 'byor bzhi tsam gyis dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'i rim pa 'ching mi thub pas nye tshe ba yin la/ yan lag bzhi yang tshang tshul rtsi ba tsam yin gyi/ don tshan ha cang mang nyung ches pa sogs shin tu 'grig pa ma yin pas/ chings kyi gtso bo yan lag drug yin no/ /'dir rdzogs rim gyi dbang du byas te/ rim pa lnga po'i ye shes rjes mthun pa skyed na lta smos kyang ci dgos/ rim lnga'i gzhi 'dings byed kyi sgrub pa/ mos pa lam byed kyi dmigs pa rnams bsgoms pas kyang*/ bskyed rim gyi lam de dag gis/ dri ma gang dag par byed pa dang*/ yon tan gang zhig 'grub par 'gyur ba'i phan yon thams cad rdzogs par 'gyur pa yin zhing*/ dbang po rnon po rnams la/ bskyed rim gyi de dang de'i dod thams cad 'dis thub par bzhed pa'o/ /gzhung dngos bstan ltar na/ gong gi bskyed rim gyi rgyas bshad kyang yin no/ /lnga pa ni/ khyad par du/ zhes pa'i rjes su/ so sor sdud dang bsam gtan dang*/ /srog rtsol de bzhin 'dzin pa dang*/ /rjes su dran dang ting nge 'dzin/ /sbyor ba drug ldan khyad par ro/ /zhes te/ skabs 'dir rgyud phyi ma'i sbyor drug gi gzhung tshig rnams blo la nges pa gal che/ de la lus dben gyi rtogs pa 'go ma rnams shar ba'i gnas skabs na/ mnyam bzhag tu rang bzhin kho na lus dben gyi lha sku la sems gnas shing*/ rjes thob tu dbang yul thams cad la bde bas rgyas btab pa na/ gzugs sogs lus snang thams cad bde stong du 'gyur 'gro tsam ni/

so sor sdud pa'o/ /lus dben gyi rnal 'byor la brtan pa thob nas/ mnyam bzhag tu ni rang du ma zad/ rang la gang snang ba thams cad lha skur 'char thub/ rjes thob tu yang bde ba dang lha skus snang ba la rgyas btab pa na/ tshur rang gi lus sems la bde ba 'phel zhing*/ snang ba yang lha skur 'char ba ni bsam gtan yin zhing*/ de'i yan lag lnga ni/ yul dbang shes pa gsum bde stong dang lha skur snang ba ni rtogs pa de nyid stong par mos pa ni dpyod pa/ stong par myong la khad pas yid bde skyes pa ni dga' ba/ stong pa myong bas lus la shin sbyangs kyi bde ba skyes pa ni bde ba/ mnyam gzhag tu gnyis snang rags pa 'gags pa ni rtse gcig pa'i yan lag go /de ltar na lus dben gyi rim pa la yan lag dang po gnyis su bzhag ste/ sor bsam gnyis ka la mnyam rjes gnyis ka yod do/ /gdong gi sna rtse dang*/ snying ga'i sna rtse dang*/ gsang ba'i sna rtser sgom pa'i ngag dben thams cad srog rtsol gyi yan lag go / sems rnam par dben pa ni 'dzin pa'i yan lag go /rgyud las/ sems ni 'gog pa'i rdo rjer 'gyur/ /zhes pa/ sems dben mthar thug gi 'od gsal dang*/ 'bar snang lugs 'byung lugs zlog rnams bstan pa yin no/ /sgyu lus kyi rim pa ni rjes dran gyi yan lag ste/ skabs 'dir rgyu lus thob nas gong 'phel du song ba'i skabs/ rjes dran bcu drug gi rnam par dbye ba dag byed do/ /'od gsal gyi rim pa ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lag ste/ sgyu lus kyi lha sku de 'od gsal du ldang 'jug yang yang byed pa'o/ /'dir rgyud las/ yud kyis ye shes rdzogs byed pa/ /zhes pa ste/ 'od gsal las sgyu lus su yang yang ldang ba'i don no/ /drug pa ni/ rim pa bzhi ldan phyag rgyar bcas/ /dbang bzhi sku bzhi rang byung bas/ /mngon par byang chub tshul lnga las/ /skyed dang sdud cing gnas pa dag /lam gyur rim pa lnga ldan pa/ /byang chub phyogs chos mdo don dang*/

/sbas pa rnam gsum mthar thug bcas/ /sna tshogs sgra ni mtshon pa'o/ /zhes pa ste/ phyag rgyar bcas pa'i lam rim pa bzhi ste/ phyag rgya bzhi'i lam yang rim lnga 'di la ldan zhing tshang ste/ bskyed rim dang lus dben la phyag rgya bzhi car gyi cha shas ni yod kyang lam gyi gzhi 'dings pa tsam yin dngos ma yin/ rdor bzlas dang sems dmigs kyi mnyam bzhag ni las rgya/ rjes thob ni chos rgya/ sgyu lus dam rgya/ 'od gsal phyag chen/ zung 'jug bzhi car gyi 'bras bu'o/ /zhes gong ma rnams gsung la/ don 'di cung zad zhib par gzhan du smra bar 'dod do/ / dbang bzhi'i lam yang 'di la tshang ste/ lus dben du bum dbang gi lam dang*/ ngag dben du gsang dbang gi lam dang*/ sems dmigs sgyu lus su sher dbang gi lam dang*/ 'od gsal zung 'jug tu bzhi pa'i lam thams cad 'dus so/ / sku bzhi lam byed kyang tshang ste/ 'chad par 'gyur ba bsre ba gsum sku gsum lam du byed tshul gyi gtso bo yin zhing*/ rnam grangs gzhan yang bshad na/ lus ngag dben pa sprul sku dang*/ sems dben chos sku dang*/ sgyu lus longs sku dang*/ 'od gsal ngo bo nyid kyi sku dang*/ zung 'jug bzhi car lam du byed pa'o/ / mngon par byang chub pa lnga las/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku dang por skyed cing 'jug tu slar bsdu ba dang*/ bar du gnas pa dag kyang lam 'di la tshang ba yin te/ stong nyid bsgom pa mnyam bzhag lus dben gyi cha shas ni de bzhin nyid las byang chub pa/ lus dben dngos ni zla ba las byang chub pa/ ngag dben ni yig 'bru las byang chub pa/ sems dben ni phyag mtshan las byang chub pa/ sgyu lus ni sku yongs rdzogs las byang chub pa'am/ yang 'od gsal ni byang chub snga ma bzhi dang*/ zung 'jug ni sku yongs rdzogs las byang chub pa yin la/ de yang mnyam bzhag zung 'jug dang po ni/ mngon byang lnga las bskyed pa zhes bya la/ de nas sprul sku zung 'jug la sogs pa sna tshogs pa 'byung ba ni zung 'jug la gnas pa zhes bya zhing*/

spyir zung 'jug gi sku rgyun 'gags pa mi srid kyang*/ lan 'ga' thugs bde stong snang med la mnyam par 'jog pa ni sdud pa zhes bya ste/ 'di ni 'bras dus kyi mngon byang lnga las sku 'grub pa dang gnas pa dang*/ sdud pa rnams rim lnga'i lam 'dis thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu byas nas/ nges par 'grub ces pa'i don yin/ bskyed rim gyi mngon byang lnga las lha sku skyed pa dang*/ 'khor tshogs spro bas gnas pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor nyer bsdus sdud pa rnams ni rdzogs rim 'di'i sngon 'gro rgyud sbyong ba'i thabs su sbyor ba yin no/ /'dir rang byung bas zhes pa ni/ sku bzhi dang mngon byang lngas mtshon pa'i ye shes lnga ni/ rang bzhin gdod ma nas rang byung lhun gyis grub pa de/ lam rim lnga bsgom pas mngon du byed ces pa'i don no/ /lam mchog tu gyur pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa 'di la ni/ mdo sde'i don byang chub phyogs chos sum cu rtsa bdun yang tshang ste/ de yang dpal nā ro pa nas brgyud pa'i 'dus pa'i gdams ngag rnams na gsal por sbyar ba med kyang*/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i man ngag rnams su ni bshad pa ltar/ 'dir yang sbyor shes dgos so/ /de yang chos mngon par mdzod las/ ming gi sgo nas rdzas su bcu/ /dad dang brtson 'grus dran pa dang*/ /shes rab ting 'dzin btang snyoms dga'/ /rtog dang tshul khrims shin tu sbyangs/ /zhes gang zag cig gi rgyud la byang phyogs so bdun yod na/ ming gi sgo nas so bdun yin gyi/ rdzas rigs bcu ru 'dus so/ /de yang dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi/ shes rab kyi dbang stobs gnyis/ chos rab tu rnam 'byed byang chub kyi yan lag yang dag pa'i lta ba ste/ brgyad po de ni shes rab gcig tu 'dus la/ yang dag spong ba bzhi/ brtson 'grus kyi dbang po stobs byang chub kyi yan lag ste gsum/ yang dag pa'i rtsol ba ste brgyad po de ni/ brtson 'grus kyi rdzas gcig la 'dus rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi/

ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po stobs byang chub yan lag gsum/ yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin te brgyad ni/ ting nge 'dzin gcig la 'dus so/ /dad pa'i dbang stobs gnyis rdzas gcig dran pa'i dbang stobs kyang rdzas gcig go /byang chub yan lag las/ btang snyoms dang*/ dga' ba dang*/ shin sbyangs te gsum/ 'phags lam la rtog pa ste/ bzhi po de re re ba yin la/ yang dag pa'i ngag dang*/ las kyimatha' dang*/ 'tsho ba gsum po ni ngo bo tshul khrims kyi rdzas su gcig go /de ltar na gong du smos pa ltar/ rim pa lnga gar stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug byang chub kyi sems yin pas mdo sngags thun mong gi byang phyogs so bdun ni de ka la tshang ba yin/ gsang sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i de rnams ngos bzung na/ dran pa ni lha sku dang bde stong*/ skad cig snga ma snga ma la shar ba des/ snang ba da ltar ba la rgyas 'debs pa de yin/ dad pa ni bla ma'i mos gus kyi lam 'khrid pa yang yin la/ lha sku dang rtsa rlung thig le bde ba sogs dmigs pa la sems dwangs zhing dga' bas rang shugs kyis gnas pa la zer/ brtson 'grus ni de dag la spro ba yang yin mod kyi/ gtso bor rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa'am sngags kyi spyod pa la zer/ ting nge 'dzin ni srog dbu mar 'gags pa'i mi rtogs pa dang*/ shes rab ni rang bzhin lhan skyes dang*/ zhu bde lhan skyes gang la yang bde bas stong nyid rtogs shing stong pas kyang bde ba rtogs pa'o/ /btang snyoms ni ye shes de dag la rtsol ba dang bral bas ngang gis 'jug pa'o/ /dga' ba ni rtsa dbu mar thig le'i 'gro 'ong gi dga' bzhi nyid do/ /rtog pa ni gsal stong bde ba de thams cad kyi rang bzhin lta zhing shes pa las sems can rnams kyang der sbyar ba'o/ /tshul khrims ni zhu bde'i thig le 'gyur med do/ /shin tu sbyang ba ni rnam rtog gi bzhon pa'i rlung dbu mar 'gags pas/ bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin la bkol du btub pa ste/

gzhan bsam gtan yan lag lnga'i shin sbyangs kyi bde ba yang yin no/ /yang rgyud kyi don tshul bzhi las/ yig don la nges po med pas 'di ltar sbyor mi dgos/ spyi don lam thun mong ba dang bskyed rim la zer/ dben gsum rang lus thabs ldan rnams snang ba sems kyis sbas pa yin/ gzhan lus shes rab rnams 'dod chags chos ky-is sbas pa yin/ sgyu lus kun rdzob bden pas sbas pa ste/ sbas don gsum po de ltar yin/ 'od gsal dang zung 'jug ni mthar thug gi don no/ /de bzhin du bden pa gnyis dang*/ rig pa bzhi dang*/ mtha' drug la sogs pa dang*/ skye ba med pa dang*/ 'gag pa med pa dang*/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sogs pa sna tshogs pa'i sgra rnams ni/ rim pa lnga po 'di nyid mtshon par byed pa'o/ /bzhi pa don tshan thor bu sna tshogs pa bstan pas/ gtum mo'i don bshad/ bsre 'phos don bshad/ 'tshang rgya ba'i dus bshad/ rdor bzlas dang snang gsum gyi 'phros bshad/ brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa bstan/ don phra mo gzhan ci rigs pa dag sbyor tshul bshad pa ste drug las dang po ni/ gtum mo'i rnal 'byor rlung gis te/ bde chen sems la dmigs pas so/ /gtum mo ni rnam pa gnyis te/ rang lus thabs ldan rnal 'byor gyi gtum mo dang*/ gzhan lus shes rab las kyi gtum mo'o/ /de yang me 'bar ba dang*/ haṃ yig zhu ba'i rnam pa dmigs pas yid la byed pa'i mi dmigs kyi gtum mor grags pa ni/ dgyes rdor sogs ma rgyud kun las shin tu gsal mod/ 'phags skor gyi gzhung man ngag thun mong ba rnams la mi gsal yang*/ kha 'gengs kyi tshul gyis bsgoms na/ shin tu bogs che ba'ang yin no/ /rgyu mtshan snying ga'i thig le bsgom pa dang*/ rtsa rlung sbyang ba'i rdor bzlas bsgom pa la 'bar 'dzag gi dmigs pa mang kyang*/ goms pa mthar phyin pa na/ rdo rje'i lus la dngos su 'bar 'dzag ni 'byung ngo*// 'di yi rigs la 'bar 'dzag gi dmigs pa ma bsgoms na/

lo tsam song ba na dngos su 'bar 'dzag yong rgyu cig la/ 'bar 'dzag gi dmigs pa 'dis bogs phyung na/ dbang po'i rim pas zla ba gcig nas zla drug tshun la dngos su 'bar 'dzag 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /spyir dngos su 'bar 'dzag 'byung phyin de lta bu'i dmigs pa bsgom pa yang*/ gdams ngag 'di la shin tu 'brel ba yin gyi ma 'brel ba ma yin no/ /des na srog rtsol la brten nas gtum mo bsgoms pa dang*/ ma rgyud yang snying gi man ngag 'di yang*/ rim lnga mar lugs kyi khyad yin zhing*/ spyir 'thad cing 'thad par ma zad rjes mar pa'i bzhed pas ni/ klu sgrub kyi rim lnga'i yang phyed dgyes rdor la brten par bzhed do/ /des na 'bar 'dzag gi gtum mo'i rnal 'byor ni/ spyir rim pa thams cad dang 'brel mod kyi/ gtso bor rlung gi rnal 'byor ngag dben dang 'brel lo/ /las kyi gtum mo'am/ bde chen las rgya'i rnal 'byor chags can 'og sgo la brten nas bde ba lam du blang ba yang*/ spyir rim lnga thams cad dang 'brel mod kyi/ gtso bor sems la dmigs pa'i sgo nas lam du byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rmi lam sgyu ma gcig tu sbyangs/ bar do rnam gsum bsre ba nyid/ /nyon mongs ye shes lam du bsgyur/ /lam myur gcod pa 'pho ba ste/ / grong du 'jug pa yan lag go /zhes te/ de la bsre ba'i man ngag gi rtsa ba ni/ rmi lam dang sgyu ma gcig tu spyod pa'o/ /rmi lam sgyu lus dang bsre thub na/ bar do yang sgyu lus dang bsre nus/ gnyid 'thug po 'od gsal dang bsre ba la yang tshegs med cing*/ de 'od gsal du chug na/ 'chi ba 'od gsal 'bad med du zin par 'gyur bas so/ /'o na rmi lam sgyu lus su 'byongs ba de/ sad dus kyi sgyu lus 'byong pa la rag las pas/ rtsa ba sad dus kyi de ma yin nam snyam na/ phyogs gcig nas de bzhin bden mod kyang*/ nyams kyi sna 'dren pa la ni phal cher la sad dus kyi sgyu ma 'byongs pa pas rmi lam gyi de 'byongs pa bla bas/

rmi lam gyi dge sbyor la brten nas nyin par gyi dge sbyor ma skyes pa skyed pa dang*/ skyes pa bogs 'byin pa gnyis kar yong ba shas che'o/ /gzhan yang srid pa bar do ste bar do dngos dang*/ rmi lam bar do dang*/ skye shi bar do'i gnas skabs rnam pa gsum po/ sgyu lus lha'i sku dang bsre ba nyid yin te/ de ltar bshad pas 'od gsal gyi bsre ba gsum po yang shugs la bstan to/ /der ma zad rim pa lnga po dug lnga dag byed du sbyor ba'am/ yang na 'dod chags dbang gis ye shes dang bsre/ zhe sdang sgyu lus dang bsre/ gti mug 'od gsal dang bsre zhes pa'i tshul gyis/ nyon mong pa la lam gyi ye shes su bsgyur bar byed de/ de yang 'di snyam du nyon mongs pas sems rgyud rab tu ma zhi zhing ma rung bar byed pa'i cha ni/ lam du mi 'gyur la/ rang bzhin spros bral rtogs na lam du 'gyur mod kyang*/ de nyon mongs ma yin pas/ nyon mongs lam du ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ spyir ma rung par byed pa'i cha de yang*/ thabs khyad par can gzhan gyis zin na/ lam du mi 'gyur ba yang ma yin la/ 'on kyang nyon mongs kyi rang bzhin shes pa zhes pa 'di/ rang bzhin ni don dam stong nyid kho na la 'jog mi dgos kyi/ 'dir rang gzugs la rang bzhin zhes bya bas/ nyon mongs pa'i shes pa de rnams nyid kyi shes pa'i rdzas gsal rig tsam de la zer ba yin/ gsal rig tsam gyi ngo bo la khyad med kyang*/ mdangs chags sdang rmongs sogs su shar ba'i grogs kyi khyad par las/ lam du byed tshul 'jug pa bde mi bde la khyad par yod de/ bde bas 'dod chags dang gsal bas zhe sdang dang stong pas gti mug lam du byed pa bla ba yin/ de las zlog na nyams kyi sne rnyed cung zad dka' bas dbye ba shes par bya'o/ /smras pa/ nyon mongs lam du byed ces kun la grags/ /bshad pa smra 'dod lkugs pa'i rmi lam 'dra/ /de de lam du byed pa'i rnal 'byor la/

/bsre ba zhes bya'i tha snyad grags pa yin/ /bsre ba'i rnam gzhag ni gnyis te/ /gzhi dang lam du bsre ba dang*/ /lam dang 'bras bur bsre ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gnyid 'od gsal du bsre/ rmi lam sgyu lus su bsre/ 'chi kha ma 'od gsal du bsre/ bar do zung 'jug tu bsre/ 'dod chags lhan skyes su bsre/ longs spyod bde stong du bsre/ zhes bsre ba drug tu snga ma rnams bzhed do/ /gnyis pa bsre ba dgu ni/ 'od gsal chos sku dang bsre/ sgyu lus la gnyis kyi mnyam bzhag longs sku dang bsre/ rjes thob sprul sku dang bsre/ gnyid 'thug 'od gsal dang bsre/ rmi lam longs sku dang bsre/ gnyid sad sprul sku dang bsre/ 'chi ba chos sku dang bsre/ bar do longs sku dang bsre/ skye ba sprul sku dang bsre/ zhes pa rnams so/ /yang bsre ba gsum ni/ bde ba chos sku dang bsre/ gsal snang longs sku dang bsre/ las snang sprul sku dang bsre ba'ang yin no/ /de'i dang po ni/ gtum mo/ las rgya/ 'od gsal gsum mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ sad dus dang*/ rmi lam dang*/ bar do gsum gyi mnyam bzhag dang rjes thob la'o/ /gsum pa ni de'i rjes so// 'pho ba la/ gong du 'pho ba dang grong du 'jug pa gnyis te/ de dag ni gtso bor ma rgyud pa la grags che de yang sad dus dang gnyid dus su/ dpe'i 'od gsal 'bad med du sgom nus pa gcig la/ gong du 'pho ba mi dgos kyang de ltar mi nus na dgos shing*/ de smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar bas/ skye ba mang po brgyud mi dgos par/ lam thams cad myur du gcod pa ste/ phyi ma'i skye ba gcig nyid la grol ba'o/ /grong du 'jug pa ni thun mong gi dngos grub tsam yin/ rdzogs rim gyi khrid kyi sde min yang*/ gong du 'pho ba'i yan lag 'phros don du bshad pa'o/ /de'i phyir 'pho ba ni 'od gsal gyi gdams ngag dang 'brel ba dang*/ grong 'jug kyang de dang 'brel bas 'dir ma 'brel ba min no/

/gsum pa ni/ 'od gsal gnas thob mngon 'tshang rgya/ /brtson 'grus can ni tshe 'di nyid/ /le lo can ni 'chi kha ste/ /tha ma srid pa bar ma dor/ / mchog thob skus ni gzhan don byed/ /ces pa la/ 'od gsal gyi gnas te rim pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor ba ni/ lus rten de la mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ste/ gson pa'i rten la 'od kyi rim pa thob na/ 'chi ba'i mngon rol tu 'tshang rgya/ 'chi ba 'od gsal gyi dus 'od gsal gyi rim pa thob na bar dor rtsol med du sangs rgya/ bar do nyid du 'od gsal gyi rim pa thob na bar do de nyid du rtsol ba dang bcas te sangs rgya'o/ /de ltar na/ brtson 'grus can ni tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgya/ le lo can rtogs pa mthon po ni/ rab 'chi kha ste 'chi ba 'od gsal las langs ma thag pa'am/ tha ma srid pa bar ma do shar mod kyang*/ skye srid med par rten de la rim pas sangs rgya ba'o/ /'dir sangs rgyas zhes pa zung 'jug thob pa'i ming yin/ slob pa'i zung 'jug thob phyin chad/ rten ma 'phos pa nyid la mi slob pa'i zung 'jug thob nges pa ni yin no/ /gong du mngon sangs rgya zhes pa'i don/ 'dir mchog thob ces pas gsal bar byas te/ mchog gi dngos grub ni zung 'jug la zer/ de thob nas sku'i sprul pa sna tshogs kyis sems can gyi don byed do/ /gzhan yang bar do'i rten la sgyu lus kyi rim pa thob pa ni/ dbang po rno na rten de la zung 'jug thob pa'ang srid/ phal cher skye ba sprul sku'i rnal 'byor gyi/ skye ba gcig len no/ /gson pa'i tshe la sgyu lus kyi rim pa thob na/ bar do tshun la mchog 'grub pas/ las nyon gyi skye ba las grol bar bshad/ 'chi ba'i sngon rol tu mched pa'i rtogs pa thob na bar dor sgyu lus kyi rim pa thob nges pa yin zhing*/ snang ba'i sa thob tsam man chad la nges pa med do/ skye ba brgyud nas sangs rgyas pa cig gzhan las bshad de/

tshe 'di la ltos na dngos grub thob pa'i grangs su mi 'gro zhing*/ phyi ma'i rang dus la ltos na gson tshe dang*/ 'chi kha dang*/ bar do gsum gang rung du 'dus pas 'dir ma bshad do/ /bzhi pa la gnyis/ ngag dben gyi 'phros dang*/ sems dben gyi 'phros so/ /dang po ni/ ngo bo rgyu tshul 'byung ba khams/ /las dang dbye ba de nyid rlung*/ / 'byung 'jug gnas pa rnam par brtag /'bru gsum sngags kyi ngo bo nyid/ /ā li kā li sbyor dbus gnas/ /brtag pa grangs ldan bzlas pa nyid/ /sbyor der khyad par thabs ldan pas/ /ngag dben rlung gi rnal 'byor bstan/ /zhes pa ste/ gong du ngag dben bstan pa rnams la rgyab brten go ba 'di ltar dgos zhes pa ste/ rlung brgya brgyad dam/ rlung bcu po rnams kyi ngo bo dang*/ phyi nang du rgyu ba'i tshul dang*/ 'byung ba che chung gi khams kyi dbye ba dang*/ rlung bcu'i byed las dang*/ gnas la sogs pa'i dbye ba dang bcas pa'i rlung de rnams nyid/ 'byung ba dang*/ 'jug pa dang*/ gnas pa'i sgo nas dbye ba du mar rnam par brtag go /de dag ni rlung gi de kho na nyid kyi skabs su dgos/ yi ge 'bru gsum po'i sngags kyi ngo bo nyid de/ phyi bskyed rim gyi sngags rnams 'dus pa'i tshul dang*/ nang rdo rje lus kyi sngags btu ba dang*/ de kho na ye shes kyi mtshon don sogs kyis brtag pa ste/ don gyi rab dbye dang ldan pas/ grangs nyi khri chig stong drug brgya bzlas pa nyid dang*/ ā li kā li sbyar ba ste/ ngag tshig kun gyi dbus na a yig srog gi tshul du gnas pa sogs sngags kyi de kho na nyid kyi rnam gzhag rgyas par shes dgos shing dgang ba dang*/ dbyung ba dang*/ bum pa can la sogs pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ rtsa a wa dhū tīr 'dus pa dang*/ 'ching ba'i khyad par gyi thabs dang ldan pas/ ngag dben rlung gi rnal 'byor brtan zhing bshad par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyu dang 'bras bu sbyor ba gang*/

/snang ba gsum po 'char tshul te/ /zhes pa ste/ snang mched thob gsum dang skad cig bzhi pa'i 'od gsal zhes lugs 'byung gi rim pa ni/ thim rim gyi snang ba gsum po rgyu dang*/ 'od gsal 'bras bur sbyong ba gang yin pa dang*/ 'od gsal las thob mched snang gsum zhes lugs zlog gi rim pa ni/ snang gsum skye ba'i rim pa ste/ 'od gsal rgyu dang snang ba gsum 'bras bu la sbyor ro/ /'dir sgyu lus kyi sku bdag byin brlab pa'i rim pa dang por 'char ba dang*/ zung 'jug gi sku 'grub pa'i dus la rgya bod phal cher lugs zlog gi snang ba'i rjes su 'byung bar bzhed pa dang*/ kha cig 'od gsal las langs pa dang*/ sku de 'grub pa srang mda'i mtho dman bzhin dus mnyam pas/ lugs zlog gi thob pa 'go shar tsa na/ sku de nyid 'grub par 'dod pa dag yod na/ snga ma 'thad de/ rnam shes gsum po slar yang ni/ zhes slar lugs zlog tu byung ba'i snang ba gsum gyi rgyu las sku de sgrub dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /lugs 'byung lugs zlog gi rim pa phra mo dag snga rol nas kyang 'byung mod kyi/ de dag las gsal snang can tsam gyi lha sku 'char ba'i dus la ni nges pa med de/ sku dngos ma yin par blo ngor shar ba tsam yin pa'i phyir ro/ /skabs 'dir rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam rtog la sogs pa'i rnam gzhag kyang rgyas par shes dgos shing*/ snang ba gsum mam bzhi la yang don dam chos nyid kyi snang gsum dang*/ kun rdzob rten 'brel gyi snang ba gsum du dbye/ dang po snang gsum dngos ma yin chos nyid do/ /phyi ma la dbye na rang bzhi dang bcas pa dang*/ rang bzhin dang bral ba gnyis/ rang bzhin dang bcas pa la dbye na/ gzhi dus dang*/ lam dus gnyis/ gzhi dus la dbye na/ rgyun chags pa rtsa ba'i snang ba gsum yin la/ khyad par gyi dus su 'byung ba la dbye na/ 'chi ba'i dus kyi snang ba gsum/ gnyid dus kyi snang ba gsum/ chags pa'i dus kyi snang ba gsum/

tshogs drug thams cad dang 'grogs pa'i snang ba gsum ste/ gzhi dus la 'jog mtshams lnga'o/ /lam dus kyi snang ba gsum la/ smin byed dbang gi dus kyi dang*/ bskyed rim dang*/ lus dben dang*/ sems dben dang*/ sgyu lus dang 'od gsal gyi rim pa'i bar te/ gnas skabs bdun po de la skad cig mas bsdus pa'i snang ba gsum mam/ snang bzhi sgrub/ sa re re yod/ sas bsdus pa'i snang bzhi ni/ sems dben du snang ba gsum gyis thob pa dang*/ 'od gsal gyi rim pa'i mtha' 'od gsal gyi sa thob pa'o/ /rang bzhin dang bral ba'i snang gsum ni/ slob pa'i zung 'jug ni yod do/ /de ltar na snang bzhi la 'jog mtshams bco lnga'o/ /zhes zur tsam mo/ /snang ba gsum dang*/ stong pa gsum dang*/ sems gsum dang*/ ye shes gsum dang*/ rnam shes gsum zhes pa rnams don gcig stong pa bzhi dang snang ba bzhi yang don gcig sems bzhi dang*/ ye shes bzhi dang*/ rnam shes bzhi tha snyad mi byed/ snang bzhi dga' bzhi don gcig kyang*/ snang ba gsum la dga' ba gsum gyi tha snyad mi byed do/ /lnga pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa bshad pa ni/ dus dang 'byung 'gyur thabs khyad par/ /dbyer med ye shes gnas thob pas/ /spyod pa ye shes mngon du byed/ /slob dang mi slob der spyod pa'o/ /rang bzhin shes pa'i lam gyur pa// rnam shes sgyu mar mtshon pa'i chos/ khyad par lus dang spyod pa gang*/ /dngos grub thob phyir bdag byin brlab/ /phyi nang mngon par byang chub tshul/ /rnal 'byor thob pa'i bsam gtan gnas/ /'byung dang 'jug pa ma brtags par/ / spyod tshul ye shes des thob pa'o/ /lha dang nyams myong lus dang ngag /bsam gtan mnyam rjes sbyong ba dang*/ /slob dang mi slob gnyis med cing*/ /rab tu mi gnas zung du 'jug /ces so/ /spyir rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa spyod pa la/ bskyed rim mthar phyin pa zhig gis/ 'phral du mchog thob par 'dod na/

de dus rig brtul gyi spyod pa mi byed par/ rdzogs rim sgoms/ de brtan na spyod pa la 'jug re zhig mchog mi 'dod par/ thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub na/ bskyed rim nyid kyi rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa spyod dgos te/ de la yang spros bcas spros med shin tu spros med gsum ka yod do/ /lus dben gyi rim pa la gnas pa'i skabs dang*/ ngag dben gyi rim pa'i skabs su ni/ spyir btang la spyod pa mi spyod de/ rdzogs rim gyi spyod pa ma ran pas so/ /'on kyang bskyed rim la bstan pa thob nas de dag sgom pa yin na/ blo'i khyad par gyis thun mong gi dngos grub la 'dod pa skyes nas/ bskyed rim la ltos pa'i spyod pa byed pa ni srid par mngon zhing*/ des dngos grub 'grub pa'ang yin no/ /phyis rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa'i rgyur/ las dang po pa nyid nas de'i bar du/ 'dod 'jug gi spyod pa dang*/ brten pa bslab pa'i spyod pa la bslab bo/ /gzhung 'dir rdzogs rim gyi spyod pa'i dbang du byas nas sems dben dang*/ sgyu lus dang*/ 'od gsal dang*/ /zung 'jug gi spyod pa ste bzhi bshad do/ /de la dus ni/ nyin re bzhin nam/ zla re'am lo re la sogs pa spros bcas kyi khyad par rnams spros bcas kyi spyod pa la dgos pa yin/ gzhan gnyis la dus nges pa med do/ /bkres skom dang*/ tsha grang la sogs pa'i gnod pa med pa dang*/ bsam pa tsam gyis gzhan la phan gnod la sogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i nus pa'am drod thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ thabs kyi khyad par spros bcas la tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor rgyas bsdus gang yin yang*/ glu gar brda sogs cho ga'i rol pa rgyas pa spyod pa dang*/ spros med la dkyil 'khor rgyas bsdus gang yin yang*/ spros pa'i rol pa mdor bsdus dang*/ shin tu spros med la rol pa spangs te bsam gtan kho nas sgrub pa rnams yin la/

spyod tshul ni/ bde stong gi ye shes mchog tu brtan pa de/ rjes chags gtso bor gyur pa'i 'dod yon gyis spel nas/ de'i steng du bde sdug mtho dman bar gsum gyi rkyen thams cad dbyer med ro mnyam du bsres pas/ bde sdug gi rgyu thams cad bde stong gi ye shes 'bar ba'i gnas thob par byed pa'o/ /spyod pa des ye shes gsum gyi sa mngon du byed ces pa ni/ snang ba'i sa ma thob kyi bar du rdzogs rim gyi spyod pa byar mi rung la/ de nas spro zhing 'dod na/ mched pa'i sa thob pa'i phyir dang de rjes thob pa'i sa mngon du byed pa la'ang spyod pa spyod pa yod mod/ nges par dgos pa ni ma yin no/ /thob pa'i sa tsam po de grub nas/ sems dben mthar thug gi 'od gsal dang*/ sgyu lus kyi rim pa thob pa'i phyir/ skabs der nges par spyod pa dgos so/ /spros bcas spros med la/ grub pa phyag rgya kho na'am/ de 'dra ji ltar 'os pa gtso bor gyur pa'i las rgya la slob pa rtag tu nges par dgos la/ shin tu spros med du ni/ las rgya la mi slob par/ ye rgya kho na dang*/ las rgya'i dkyil 'khor gyi dod gnyid kyi 'od gsal gyis sgrub pa ste/ skabs der de ltar spyad do/ /sgyu lus kyi rim pa thob nas ni/ rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam rtog sgyu ma lta bur shes pa'i lam mngon du gyur pa ni/ rnam shes gsum yang sgyu ma lta bur mtshon nus pa'i chos/ lha sku snang stong dang zhu bde la mnyam par 'jog cing*/ khyad par las dge sdig gi rgyur 'gyur pa'i rigs/ dge mi dge lung ma bstan gyi rnam rtog thams cad ro snyam pa dang*/ dbye ba spyod pa gsum po gang dgadangos kyi 'bras bu phra yang la sogs pa yon tan brgyad kyi dngos grub thob pa'i phyir sgrub pa ni bdag byin brlab pa'i rim pa'i spyod pa'o/ /'o na sgyu lus kyi rim pa mthar phyin tshad kyis/ yon tan brgyad thob par 'gyur ram snyam nas/

de tsam la ma nges kyang*/ zung 'jug 'grub pa'i sngon rol zla ba drug nas thob par bshad pas/ de 'od gsal kyi rim pa'i mgo sgang la 'byung bas/ sgyu lus kyi spyod pa'i 'bras bu thun mong ma yin par gyur pa la dgongs so/ /'od gsal gyi rim pa thob zin pa'i spyod pa ni/ zhu bde la brten nas rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa shin tu gsal bar mtshon nus/ rnam rtog rlung dang bcas pa'i cha shas 'ga' zhig mngon 'gyur gtan nas 'gags pa las byung ba'i bde stong gi rnal 'byor thob pas/ spyod pa gsum po gang rung gi cho ga dang sbyar nas/ ril gzhig gi bsam gtan gnyis po gang rung re la gnas pas snang bzhi'i rim pas 'od gsal du 'jug pa dang*/ slar yang de las snang gsum lugs zlog dang sgyu lus su ldang ba ni/ blo rnam rtog gis ma brtags par/ phyag rgya'i ye shes kho nas 'byung ste/ spyod pa spyod tshul gyi ye shes de lta bu ni/ 'od gsal gyi rim pa la gnas pa'i gang zag des thob bo/ /'od gsal gyi rim pa 'di'i mthar thug pa phyi nang gi mngon byang gnyis sbyar ba las/ don gyi 'od gsal mthong lam thob pa ni spyod pa khyad par can yin la/ der ma zad 'od gsal gyi rim pa'i spyod pa thams cad/ phyi nang gi mngon par byang chub pa gnyis kyi tshul te 'dra 'bag tu 'byung ba'o/ /des rjes su zung 'jug gi spyod pa la ni/ spros bcas spros med shin tu spros med la sogs pa'i tha snyad tsam 'jog pa ni/ gnas skabs yul dus de dang der gdong thug tu gdul bya gzhan snang ba ji ltar snang ba'am/ rnam par 'phrul ba de dang der bstan pa la/ spros bcas la sogs pa'i ming so sor 'dogs par zad kyi snga ma rnams kyi skabs dang mi 'dra'o/ /dngos su ni mtshan dpe thams cad rdzogs pa'i ye shes kyi sku las sku'i snang ba chad pa med pa 'byung ba dang*/ grag stong nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i gsung las sgra dbyangs rgya mtsho dang*/

bde stong lhan cig skyes pa'i thugs kyis rten 'brel ji snyed pa mkhyen pa ste/ rdo rje gsum rnal 'byor mi rtog pa'i ngang las ma g.yos bzhin du bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam par 'phrul pas sems can gyi don mdzad pa ni/ zung 'jug gi ye shes yin la/ rim lnga las/ zung du 'jug pa sgoms gyur pas/ / spyod pa'ang de dang gnyis su med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar zung 'jug gi ye shes nyid las gzhan pa'i rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa ni med la/ 'on kyang mnyam bzhag tu lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes bde stong nyid kyi nyams myong de rjes thob sems can gyi don spyod pa'i gnas skabs su/ brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad la rgyas btab pas/ de rnams lhan skyes gcig pu'i ngo bor ro mnyam du thim par 'gyur pa'i ldog cha nas ni/ rig brtul zhes bya la/ 'di ye shes kyi rnam rol 'ba' zhig yin yang*/ rnam pa rjes chags kyi rol pa'i dkyil 'khor du shar ba dang*/ gnyis snang gi 'khrul ba rnams zhu bde phra mos rgyas btab pa'i rkyen gyi don dam pa'i dbyings su bsre pa'i byed las kyi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa ni dgos so/ /de ltar na mnyam bzhag tu yod med yin min rtag chad 'gro 'ong skyes 'gag 'phel 'grib sogs gnyis snang dang spros pa gang la yang rab tu mi gnas shing*/ rjes thob tu gzung 'dzin gnyis snang tsam cig yod kyang*/ mnyam bzhag gi shugs kyis so sor blos 'dzin pa la rab tu mi gnas pa ni zung 'jug gi spyod pa'o/ /de yang lha'i sku dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang*/ bde stong gi nyams myong gnyis dbyer med ngo bo gcig pa dang*/ lus dang ngag dang yid gsum tha dad med de/ sku dang gsung yang thugs ye shes gcig gi rnam rol yin pa dang*/ ril 'dzin dang rjes gzhig gi bsam gtan gnyis kyi 'od gsal du ldang 'jug byed pa'i dbye ba med pa dang*/ mnyam bzhag dang rjes thob kyi spyod pa tha dad pa med pa dang*/

slob pa dang mi slob pa ste las kyi phyag rgya sogs rjes chags kyi rol pa la slob par snang zhing nges par sgrub dgos pa dang*/ skabs 'gar de bkag ste mi slob pa'i blang dor gyi dbye ba gnyis med pa'o/ /sa brgyad pa yan chad mnyam rjes so so'i mtshan nyid med la/ 'on kyang 'dir mnyam rjes tha dad med pa ni de gnyis la nyams len mi 'dra ba med/ bogs che chung med ces pa'o/ /'dir zung 'jug gi ye shes la kha sbyor sogs yan lag bdun ldan gyi rnam gzhag byed pa ni spyir shin tu bzang zhing dngos po'i gnas tshul la shin tu zhugs pa yin yang*/ yan lag bdun ldan gyi rnam gzhag 'di ni/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi bzhed pa yin gyi/ rim lnga spyod bsdus sgron gsal sogs 'phags lugs kyi rtsa ba'i gzhung 'grel gang nas kyang bshad pa med do/ /bod kyi 'phags skor ba mang po yan lag bdun ldan gyi bshad pa/ yang skyor byed kyin 'phags lugs rang gi chos skad yin pa skad ngom ngom byed pa ni gzhung gang dang gang las/ chos skad de dang de byung ba ma shes pa'o/ /gzhan yang spyod pa'i skabs 'dir go dgos la/ spros bcas spros med shin tu spros med gsum po la/ cho ga la ltos pa'i spros bcas sogs gsum/ dus la ltos pa'i gsum/ sgom bsam la ltos pa'i gsum ste dgur phye nas/ ming gsal med pa rnams phal cher cho ga'i dbang du byas pa'o/ kha cig gzhan lus sam/ 'og sgo'i lam ste chags lam bye brag pa dang*/ rig brtul kyi spyod pa gcig par 'dod pa ni ma sbyangs pa'i blun gtam yin te chags lam bye brag pa de ni/ zhu bde lhan cig skyes pa'i nyams ma thob pa thob pa'i phyir sgrub pa dang*/ skyes pa brtan pa'i phyir sgrub pa yod cing*/ de yi dang po la yang*/ ring pa'i rgyu rlung dbu ma'i sgor bsdu ba dang*/ bar pa dbu mar gzhug pa dang*/ thim pa tsam po byed pa dang*/ gtum mo rags pa sbar bar byed pa sogs yod cing*/

nye bar rgyu rjes chags kyi gtum mo phra ba sbar ba'o/ /phyi ma la yang gtum mo sbar ba brtan par byed pa dang*/ thig le'i bgrod pa brtan par byed pa'i phyir du sgom pa sogs rigs du ma yod kyang*/ de thams cad rig brtul gyi spyod par mi 'gro ba sha stag dang*/ ye shes brtan zin pa bogs 'byin byed pa la yang brtul zhugs gyi spyod pas ma khyab cing*/ spyod pa la yang gzhan lus yin pas ma khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du rigs spyod ni bde ba sgrub byed tsam dang*/ 'dod yon lam byed tsam dang rig ma'i kha sbyor gyis 'dod chags lam byed tsam dang*/ rkyen ngan lam 'khyer tsam dang*/ nyon mongs glo bur du sbyong byed tsam dang*/ nyon mongs bag la zha ba rnams mngon gyur du ston nas sbyong byed tsam du 'dod pa sogs legs par ma sbyangs pa'i mkhas par 'dod pa rnams la rig brtul ji bzhin ngos ma zin pa'i bla rdol nges med sna tshogs pa byung ngo*/ /drug pa don phra mo ci rigs dang sbyar ba la/ yi ge'i don dang spyi yi don// sbas pa mthar thug nyid yin te/ /zhes 'byung ste/ gong gi sbas pa rnam gsum sogs dang don gcig theg pa sna tshogs pha rol phyin/ /srid pa skye dang gnas la sogs/ /dus kyi dbye ba khyad par gyi/ /stan gcig steng du bsgom par bya// zhes 'byung ste/ don 'og tu 'chad 'gyur dang gcig des na tshig 'di rnams dpe phal cher la 'dug kyang*/ gzhung 'di nyid kyi dkyus yin na/ brjod bya zlog pa'i skyon du 'gyur bas/ gzhung 'dra min gcig nas tshur blangs par zad do// 'dir gnas la sogs zhes pa gong du bsgom pa'i/ gnas dang*/ sgrub pa po dang*/ grogs dang*/ nyams su blang pa'i gdams pa ste/ rtsis mgo bzhi byed pa la bsams par 'dug cing*/ dus ni gong du bshad pa'i gnad bzhi'i nang tshan no/ /'di dag zlos skyon du song gi dogs nas/ 'di nyid yang dag rtogs pa'i phyir/

/zhes pa bcug ste/ snga ma'i theg pa sna tshogs sogs bsgom par gdams pa dang*/ phyi mas sgom pa'i phyir du go ba dogs pas/ theg pa sna tshogs sogs dang sbyar te bshad par bya'o byas na legs par 'ong ngo bsam pa'o/ /des na yi ge'i don dang bcas pa nas/ rtogs pa'i phyir zhes pa'i bar gyi tshig rkang bdun po 'di snga phyi dang zlog pa yin la/ gdan rdzogs kyi yig rnying rnams la lung drangs pa la ni/ theg pa sna tshogs sogs snga ma 'di mi 'byung*/ 'chad 'gyur gyi tshig bcad gcig po 'di 'byung bas/ dkyus kyi gzhung tshig ni 'di yin no/ /de yang*/ lam mchog rim pa lnga pa nyid/ /pha rol phyin dang theg sna tshogs/ /srid pa skye dang nyin zhag gcig /stan gcig steng du sbyar te bshad/ /ces te/ lam rim pa lnga po 'di ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo don gyi dgongs pa yang yin te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gdan seng ge'i khri bshams te/ sku lus drang por bsrangs/ zhes sogs kyis lus dben bstan/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs kyi mthil gnyis las 'od zer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong drug cu drug cu byung*/ zhes sogs kyis rdor bzlas bstan/ nang stong pa nyid la sogs pa stong nyid bco brgyad rgyas bshad kyis sems dben bstan/ gzugs sgyu ma lta bu sogs kyis sgyu lus bstan/ gzugs kyi rang bzhin ni rang bzhin med pa ste/ gang la rang bzhin med pa de ni brjod du med pa'o/ /zhes sogs kyis 'od gsal bstan/ gnyis su med gnyis su byar med/ so so ma yin tha mi dad do zhes pas zung 'jug bstan to/ /de yang sher phyin gyi mdo'i dngos bstan ni rdzogs rim rnams dang don phyogs 'dra ba de tsam ka gsungs pa yin yang*/ phugs kyi dgongs pa'i brtad so rim lnga la dgongs te/ gsungs pa yin pas/ mthar thug gi dgongs don ni 'di kho na'o/ /sher phyin gyi mdo ni theg chen gyi mdo sde phal gyi rtsa ba yin pas/

smos par zad kyi/ des mtshon nas mdo gzhan kun la'ang go bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du theg pa dang*/ grub mtha' sna tshogs pa'i nyams rtogs rnams kyang 'di la 'dus pa yin te/ nyan thos kyi lam bsgom pa rnams la/ kun rdzob rags pa'i snang ba mi 'gog cing*/ rdul phran la mngon zhen dang bcas mod/ lhag ma bdag med rtog pa'i shes rab ni/ bskyed rim lus dben dang bcas pa'i gzugs can phra rags su snang ba ma 'gags pa la gzhi sgyur pa'i rnam pa can de dang chos mtshungs pa'i sgo nas/ nyan thos kyi de 'dir 'dus pa yin te/ 'di bsgoms pa'i nyan thos kyi spang rtogs de dag mtha' dag rdzogs pa'i rten 'brel byed do/ /rdor bzlas su rang rgyal gyi theg pa 'dus te/ de'i lam gyi gtso bo rten 'brel bcu gnyis bsgoms pa yin la/ rlung 'pho ba bcu gnyis ni rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi rlung yin/ de la rdor bzlas byas pas rten 'brel bcu gnyis rtogs par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /nyan thos sde gnyis kyi grub mtha' rnam dag gi nyams thams cad nyan rang 'phags pa'i rtogs pa la 'dus so/ /sems tsam gyi lta ba phyi don du snang ba'i bkod pa thams cad kyang*/ sems kyi rnam 'gyur du shes pa dang*/ sems dmigs kyi rim par yang*/ rdo rje 'phreng ba las/ snying por gyur pa rang srog las/ khams gsum na ni gzhan med de/ /sgyu ba rlung gi khams gsum po/ /rmi lam rmi ba bzhin du snang*/ /zhes chos thams cad rlung sems kyi rtsa ba can du shes shing*/ rlung yang sems las gzhan du med par rtogs pa/ rtogs rigs mthun pa'i phyir de 'dir 'dus so/ /dbu ma sgyu ma lta bur smra ba'i rtogs pa yang sgyu lus su 'dus te/ snang grag sgyu ma lta bur rtogs par 'dra bas so/ /dbu mar rab tu mi gnas pa'i rtogs pa ni 'od gsal du 'dus te/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzh-in stong pa brjod bral du de dag 'dod cing 'dis myong ba'i phyir ro/

/dbu ma 'di gnyis thal rang gi ming gi rnam grangs su 'dod pa ni mi legs te/ thal rang gnyis ma yin pa'i dbu ma de gnyis du ma yod cing*/ de gnyis la yang gnyis kyis ma khyab pa'i phyir ro/ / sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i lta ba thams cad zung 'jug tu 'dus te/ gsang sngags rgyud sde thams cad kyi gnas lugs dgongs pa'i mthar thug bde stong dang dkyil 'khor zung du 'jug pa gdod ma'i ngo bo de kho na yin pa'i phyir ro/ / de ltar na rim lnga bsgoms pas theg pa mtha' dag gi lam bsgom par 'gyur ro/ /srid pa skye ba'i rim pa dang sbyar na/ lus grub pa tsam lus dben/ dbugs rgyu ba ngag dben/ gnyid dang snyoms 'jug gi dus snang gsum 'char ba ni sems dben/ rmi lam gyi lus ni sgyu lus/ 'chi dus kyi stong pa bzhi ni 'od gsal/ bar do'i lus ni longs sku zung 'jug slar yang skye ba'i lus blangs pa ni sprul sku zung 'jug ste/ 'di dag ni sbyang bya ngos gzung ba'am/ gang la gnad du bsnun pa'i gzhi chen yang yin no/ /yang na yul snang skad cig re re dang*/ gnyid dang*/ snyoms 'jug dang*/ 'chi ba'i dus kyi thim rim thams cad/ sems dben 'od gsal gnyis kyi thun mong dang*/ gnyid dang sad dus kyi snang ba shar ba dang*/ rmi lam dang bar do thams cad sgyu lus zung 'jug thun mong du sbyar yang rung ngo*/ /nyin zhag phrugs gcig dang sbyar na/ phung po lnga sangs rgyas lnga'i rang bzhin ni lus dben/ rlung nyi khri chig stong drug brgya rgyu ba ni rdor bzlas/ gnyid la 'jug pa ni sems dben/ rmi lam ni sgyu lus/ gnyid 'thug po ni 'od gsal/ gnyid sad pa ni zung 'jug dang sbyar ro/ /zhes pa 'di yang sbyang bya nyid dang*/ gnas skabs der dag sbyor gang zhig 'jug pa'i tshul lo/ / de ltar na rim lnga stan thog gcig tu bsgoms pas/ srid pa skye ba dang*/ nyin zhag gcig gi bya ba rnams/ ye shes kyi rten du 'gyur zhing*/

mdo don sna tshogs dang theg pa thams cad stan thog gcig tu rdzogs pa'o/ /rgyas bshad rtsa ba'i gsum pa ni/ 'di ltar/ 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa nyid/ /tshe 'di nyid du sangs rgyas pa/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug dam pa ste/ /sku lnga rab rdzogs gyur pa'o/ /zhes te/ 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa ni/ sa dang por slob pa'i zung 'jug thob/ de 'dra'i gang zag de tshe 'di nyid du 'chi srid kyis bar ma chod par sangs rgyas pa zhes bya/ sa gnyis pa nas bcu pa'i bar du bgrod pa ni rnal 'byor can gyi dbang phyug dam pa'am mchog ces bya ste/ de'i rjes su mi slob pa'i zung 'jug sku lnga dang*/ ye shes lnga dang*/ dbang phyug brgyad la sogs gzhal du med pa'i yon tan thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa yin te/ sku lnga ni ngo bo nyid sku dang*/ ye shes chos sku dang*/ longs spyod rdzogs pa dang*/ sprul pa dang*/ bde ba chen po'i sku rnams yin la/ de'i mdzad pa 'phrin las kyang lhun gy-is grub cing phyogs dus kun tu khyab pa'o/ /gsum pa man ngag gi che ba bstan pa ni/ dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud/ /'phags pa yab sras rim bshad pa/ /de nyid dgongs pa na ros rnyed/ /'grel pa mkhan gyis mi shes pas/ /rgyud rkyang snying po bstus pa nyid// byin rlabs lam 'di thun mong min/ /zhes pa la/ rgyud ces pa ni rgyud don no// rim zhes pa ni zhal gyi gdams pa'i rim pa'o/ /'grel pa mkhan de/ rje mar pa'i gsung gis/ da sa tha ga na dang*/ dza ya na/ snyim pa'i me tog gsum thos te/ bla ma'i man ngag can ma yin gsungs nas mi 'chad/ ces 'byung ba ltar paṇ+ḍi ta'i rtsal bshad rnams la zer ba yin gyi/ sgron gsal la zur za min mod/ mkhas pa 'ga' zhig der dogs nas tshig 'di la thugs shin tu snyung ngo*/ /rje btsun mar los bod du sgron gsal bshad bka' mtshungs zer yang mi bden te/ sgron gsal gyi yig sna mar lugs 'dug pa'i phyir ro/

/rgyud rkyang gi bshad pa de yang sgron gsal gyi snying po bsdus pa ka yin pas sgron gsal gyi pho rus su bsams nas phyir 'bud byed mi dgos so/ /thun mong min pa ni snying ga'i sngags 'khor la sogs pa'i man ngag dang*/ bsre 'pho la sogs kyi rnam gzhag dang man ngag ste/ 'phags skor ba gzhan la'ang ma grags pa'o/ /byin rlabs lam zhes pa rim pa lnga car gyi man ngag la nyams myong phyin ci ma log par shar ba'i rgyun yod pas/ slob ma la yang nyams myong 'phral du skye ba'i nus pa yod pa'o/ /gzhung gi mthar mtshan smos pa ni/ rim pa lnga'i don bsdus pa gsal ba zhes bya ba/ dpal nā ro pas mdzad pa'i gsang ba'i man ngag bla ma'i zhal las rtogs par bya ba rdzogs so/ /zhes pa'o/ /dpe 'ga' zhig las/ rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po de nyid dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba mar ba chos kyi blo gros kyis bsgyur zhing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o/ /zhes pa'i 'gyur byang yang yod do/ /'dir smras pa/ rgyud sde kun gyi bzhugs tshul cha tsam rig khyad par gsang pa 'dus par cung zad sbyangs/ /'phags skor gzhung la'ang ngal ba bag tsam bsten/ /mar lugs phyogs kyi gzhung bshad phal cher mthong*/ /zab mo'i gzhung mchog 'di nyid ni/ /tshig nyung don ni shin tu rgyas/ /gzhan gyi 'grel pa ma mthong mod/ /gzhung la zhib mor brtag pas go /sbyangs shing go nas bshad pa yin/ /slob long med par mkhas grags 'dod/ /blun po mgu byed kho nar zad/ /rgyu med 'bras bu mi 'byung ngo*/ /rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam gyi mchog /cung zad bshad pa'i dge bas kyang*/ /nam mkha' mthas gtugs sems can rnams/ /rdo rje 'dzin dang mnyam par shog /ces pa/ rim lnga bsdus gsal gyi 'grel pa 'di ni/ 'jig rten mgon po stag lung thang pas sku gsung thugs la byin gyis brlabs shing*/ rigs mchog gser gyi ri bo'i rtse mor bsngags par 'os pa'i yon tan gyi nyin byed brgya phrag rtag tu 'char ba'i skyes mchog dam pa/

rje ngag dbang bkra shis dpal grub kyi gsung gis bskul nas/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas sbyar ba'o/ /gzhung 'di sdom gyi tshul du snang bas 'bru bshig pa tsam gyis don mthong ba dga' bar 'dug pas/ don cha tshang ba zur smos kyis brjod pa yin no// //zhus dag maṅga laṃ/

'dir 'bad dge ba rnam par dkar ba'i mthus/ /bdag lus bor tshe dpal ldan sham+bha lar/ /rigs ldan rgyal po'i 'khor du legs skyes nas/ /dus 'khor bstan la bya ba byed par shog /ces pa 'di ni chos rje phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis smon lam btab pa'o/ /dge ba 'di yis glo bur dri ma'i tshogs/ /srog dang thur sel rtsa dang lhan cig du/ /'joms par nus pa'i thabs zab la brten nas/ /gzhan mchog bde gshegs snying po myur thob shog /ces pa 'di ni rton pa bzhi ldan gyis smon lam mdzad pa'o/ /dus kyi 'khor lo bla ma dbyer med la/ /gus pas skyabs gsol 'dir bsags rab dkar mthus/ /sham+bha la ru rigs ldan sras gyur te/ /bstan 'gro yongs la rlabs chen phan thogs shog /ces pa'ang ma tis so/ /bsod nams bsags dges bdag sogs 'gro/ /'di phyi kun tu yang dag gi /chos mthun kho nas legs 'tsho zhing*/ /rkyen ngan gang gis bsgyur med shog /ces pa'ang ma tis so// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/rim lnga bsdus gsal gyi ṭī ka bzhugs/ -PAGE 342--PAGE 341--PAGE 261-
